It is said:
The Buddha’s body pervades all great assemblies, filling the entire dharma realm without end;
it is quiescent, devoid of intrinsic nature, and ungraspable, yet it appears for the sake of saving the world.
The Tathāgata, the Dharma King, has appeared in the world, Able to light the wondrous lamp of the Dharma that illuminates the world;
His realm is boundless and inexhaustible. This is what is realized by the one named Sovereign;
The Buddha is inconceivable and free from discrimination, Having understood that throughout the ten directions, nothing exists.
He has extensively opened the path of purity for the world;
with such pure eyes, he is able to behold the Tathāgata’s wisdom, which is without limit. No one in all the worlds can fathom it;
he forever extinguishes the ignorant and darkened minds of sentient beings. With great wisdom, he enters and dwells securely within this profound state.
The Tathāgata’s merit is inconceivable; those sentient beings who behold him have their afflictions extinguished.
He causes all the world to obtain peace and happiness.
The sovereign Īśvara, though immovable, can see that sentient beings are constantly deluded and shrouded by the darkness of ignorance; for them, the Tathāgata preaches the Dharma of tranquility.
This is the lamp of wisdom that illuminates the world; With wondrous eyes, one can know these skillful means.
The Tathāgata’s pure and wondrous form-body Appears universally throughout the ten directions, beyond compare.
This body has no intrinsic nature and no place of dependence; It is that which the well-considered devas observe.
The Tathāgata’s voice is without limit or obstruction;
those capable of being transformed hear it without exception, yet the Buddha remains tranquil and eternally unmoving.
This is the liberation of the Joyful Wisdom Deva—tranquil liberation— O Lord of Gods, nowhere throughout the ten directions is he not manifest before them.
The radiance of light fills the world; this Unobstructed Dharma Banner saw the Buddha during an ocean of boundless great kalpas.
For the sake of sentient beings, he sought Bodhi and transformed all through various supernormal powers; the deity Renowned Light realized this Dharma.

Furthermore, the Celestial King Banner of the Radiance of Dharma Delightful to Behold attained the liberation door of universally observing the faculties of all sentient beings to preach the Dharma and sever their doubts.
The Celestial King Ocean of Pure Adornments attained the liberation door of causing [beings] to see the Buddha according to their recollections.
The Celestial King Light of Supreme Wisdom attained the adornment of the equality of the nature of phenomena (*dharmatā*), which is without dependence.
The Heavenly King Sovereign Wisdom Banner attained the liberation door of knowing all worldly dharmas and establishing inconceivable oceans of adornments within a single thought-moment.

The Heavenly King Delighting in Quiescence attained the liberation door of manifesting inconceivable Buddha-fields within a single pore without obstruction. The Heavenly King Universal Wisdom Eye attained...
The Deva King Joyful Revolution of Wisdom attained the liberation door of manifesting in various ways for all sentient beings, remaining ever-present throughout boundless eons.
The Deva King Radiance of the Light of Good Roots attained the liberation door of observing all worldly realms and entering the inconceivable Dharma. The Stainless Tranquility...
The Celestial King Śāntiprabha attained the liberation door of demonstrating the essential Dharma for the deliverance of all sentient beings.
The Celestial King Vistīrṇaviśuddhaprabha attained the liberation door of observing all sentient beings who are to be transformed and causing them to enter the Buddha-dharma.
At that time, the Celestial King Priyadharmaprabhāsavaijayanta, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, universally surveyed all the Limited and Vast [Worlds].
The assembly of the Akaniṣṭha and Bṛhatphala devas spoke in verse:
“The realm of the Buddhas is inconceivable; No sentient beings can fathom it.
May they all give rise to faith and understanding, With vast resolve that is inexhaustible.”
If there are sentient beings capable of receiving the Dharma, the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power guides them,
causing them to constantly behold the Buddha appearing before them.
Just as the Sea-Adornment Heavenly King thus perceives that the nature of all phenomena has no basis, so too does the Buddha appear in the world.
Universally throughout all realms of existence, there is no place of reliance; this meaning can be observed through supreme wisdom according to the desires of the minds of all sentient beings.
Through the Buddha’s power of spiritual transformations, he can manifest each distinct and inconceivable [manifestation];
this is the ocean of liberation of the King of Wisdom Banners.
All the lands that existed in the past are all manifested within a single pore;
this is the great supernormal power of the Buddhas.
Those who delight in tranquility can proclaim the inexhaustible ocean of all dharma-gates, gathering together within the site of enlightenment of the single Dharma.
Such is the nature of phenomena as taught by the Buddha; With the eye of wisdom, one can clarify these skillful means.
All the lands existing throughout the ten directions— Within them all, he preaches the Dharma.
The Buddha-body neither goes nor comes; It is the realm of the revolving wheel of joyful wisdom.

The Buddha contemplates the phenomena of the world as mere reflections of light; Entering those most profound and mysterious depths, he proclaims that the nature of all dharmas is eternally quiescent.
Those with virtuous seeds who contemplate well can perceive this;
The Buddha thoroughly understands all realms and, according to the faculties of sentient beings, rains down the rain of Dharma.
To open the gateway to the inconceivable means of liberation, this Śāntadeva is able to enter into realization;
the World-Honored One, ever with great compassion, appears for the benefit of sentient beings and rains down the Dharma equally upon all vessels; Viśuddhaprabhadeva is able to expound it.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Renowned Wisdom attained the liberation door of skillful means for realizing the path of liberation of all sentient beings.
The Celestial King Supreme Vision attained the liberation door of manifesting universally according to the inclinations of all the celestial hosts, like reflections in light and shadows.
The Celestial King Tranquil Virtue attained the universal adornment and purification of all Buddha-realms.

The Heavenly King Great Skillful Means attained the liberation door of the elements. The Heavenly King Sumeru Sound attained the liberation door of following all sentient beings as they perpetually wander through the ocean of birth and death.
The Heavenly King Pure Mindfulness Eye attained the liberation door of recollecting the Tathāgata’s practices for taming sentient beings.
The Heavenly King Lovely Universal Radiance attained the flow from the ocean of the universal gate dhāraṇī.

They emerged from gates of liberation. The Celestial King Sovereign of the World attained the gate of liberation called "The Treasury for Causing Sentient Beings to Encounter Buddhas and Give Rise to Faith.
The Celestial King Sovereign of Radiant Flames attained the gate of liberation called "Causing All Sentient Beings to Hear the Dharma, Believe with Joy, and Attain Deliverance.
The Celestial King Transformation of Delighting in Contemplating the Dharma attained entry into all bodhi...
The celestial king Sādhupravṛtti attained the liberation door of subduing beings like space, which is boundless and inexhaustible.
The celestial king Vikurvaṇadhvaja attained the liberation door of universally compassionate wisdom that observes the immeasurable afflictions of sentient beings.
The celestial king Jyotirghoṣasuvyūha attained the liberation door of emitting light to manifest the Buddha’s three wheels of conversion. At that time, the one named Viśuddhamati...
The Celestial King, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed all the hosts of the Parīttābha,
Apramāṇābha, and Ābhāsvara devas, and spoke in verse:
“Those who thoroughly understand the unimpeded nature of phenomena Manifest throughout the infinite lands of the ten directions.”
He proclaims the inconceivable realm of the Buddha, Causing all beings to return together to the ocean of liberation.
The Tathāgata dwells in the world without dependence, Like light and shadows appearing in all lands.
The nature of phenomena is ultimately without arising; This is the gateway entered by King Jina-darśana.
Having cultivated skillful means for an ocean of immeasurable eons, He universally purifies all lands throughout the ten directions;
The Dharma-realm is suchness, eternally unmoving— This is what the deity Śāntaguṇa has realized.
Sentient beings are shrouded by ignorance and obscured, Blind and dark, they dwell perpetually within birth and death.
The Tathāgata reveals the path of purity; This liberation of Sumerughoṣa is the unsurpassed path practiced by all Buddhas.
No sentient beings can fathom it, yet he reveals it through various doors of skillful means; One who observes with pure eyes can fully comprehend it.
The Tathāgata constantly uses the gates of dhāraṇī— As numerous as the atoms in oceans of lands—to instruct and transform sentient beings throughout all places;
King Universal Radiance, one is able to enter this:
The appearance of a Tathāgata in the world is extremely difficult to encounter, Met but once in an ocean of immeasurable eons.
He is able to cause sentient beings to give rise to faith and understanding; this is what the Sovereign Deva has attained.
The Buddha teaches that the nature of phenomena is entirely without inherent nature—profound, vast, and inconceivable—and causes all beings everywhere to give rise to pure faith;
the King of the Radiant Flame Devas is well able to comprehend this.
The Tathāgatas of the three periods of time are full of merit; their transformation of the realms of sentient beings is inconceivable.
To contemplate this gives rise to joy; such delight in the Dharma can be expounded and revealed.
Sentient beings are submerged in the ocean of afflictions; the turbidity of ignorance and views is truly terrifying.
The Great Master, out of compassion, causes them to be forever freed from this;
it is the realm perceived by King Transformation Banner, wherein the Tathāgata constantly emits great rays of light.
Within each ray of light are immeasurable Buddhas, each manifesting the work of transforming sentient beings; this is the gateway entered by Wondrous Sound.

Furthermore, the Celestial King Light of Delightful Radiance attained the liberation door of being able to manifest chains that extinguish the sufferings of the world while constantly experiencing tranquil bliss.
The Celestial King Pure Sublime Light attained the liberation door of the ocean-like treasury of joy and happiness for all sentient beings, which corresponds with a heart of great compassion.
The Celestial King Sovereign Sound attained [the liberation door] of universally [illuminating] within a single thought-moment.
The gate of liberation of manifesting the power of the merit of all sentient beings throughout boundless eons was attained by the Celestial King Supreme Mindfulness and Wisdom;
the gate of liberation of universally causing all worlds—whether forming, abiding, or decaying—to be entirely pure like empty space was attained by him.
The Celestial King Lovely and Delightful Pure Sound attained the liberation door of lovingly delighting in and faithfully accepting all the teachings of the sages.
The Celestial King Well-Considered Sound attained the liberation door of being able to remain for eons while expounding the meaning of all stages (*bhūmi*) and their skillful means (*upāya*).
The Celestial King Sound of Expounded Adornments attained [the state wherein] all bodhisattvas [descend] from the Tuṣita Heaven palace...
The gate of liberation through skillful means for making great offerings at the time of descending to be born;
the gate of liberation of the profound King of Heaven of Radiant Sound, who attains the ocean of inexhaustible wisdom and supernatural powers of observation;

the gate of liberation of the King of Heaven of Vast Renown, who attains the power of skillful means for manifesting in the world with the fulfillment of the ocean of merits of all Buddhas; and the King of Heaven of Supreme Pure Light...
The Celestial King attained the liberation door of the treasury of profound faith and joyful love, which arises from the power of the Tathāgata’s past vows.
At that time, the Celestial King Light of Lovely Radiance, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed all the assemblies of the Gods of Limited Light,
the Gods of Immeasurable Light, and the Gods of Utmost Light, and spoke these verses:
I recall the deeds performed by the Tathāgata in the past, Serving and making offerings to boundless Buddhas;
Through his original faith and pure karma, And by the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, I now see them all.
The Buddha-body is signless and free from all defilement, Ever abiding in the ground of compassion and pity.
All worldly sorrows and afflictions are caused to be removed; this is the liberation of Sublime Light.
The Buddha-dharma is vast and boundless, with all oceans of lands appearing within it;
their formations and destructions are each different, through the power of the liberation of the Celestial Lord Sovereign Sound.
The Buddha’s power of spiritual penetrations is peerless; he universally manifests throughout the vast lands of the ten directions, causing them all to be purified and ever-present before him.
With the skillful means of supreme mindfulness and liberation, as numerous as the atoms within oceans of lands, he is reverently honored by all Tathāgatas.
Hearing the Dharma and becoming free from defilement is not in vain; this is the application of the Dharma-gate of the Celestial King Sublime Sound.
The Buddha, throughout an ocean of immeasurable great eons, has taught the skillful means of the stages (bhūmi) in a manner peerless and incomparable;
what he has spoken is boundless and inexhaustible—the Celestial King Skillful Thought-Sound knows this meaning.
The Tathāgata’s gateways of spiritual transformations are immeasurable; in a single thought-moment, he manifests in all places.

Through the great skillful means of descending from heaven and attaining enlightenment, this liberation of Adorned Sound, sustained by majestic power, is able to expound upon them and manifest the supernatural feats of all Buddhas.
Purifying all according to their faculties and inclinations—this is the liberation door of the Light-Sound Heaven.
The wisdom of the Tathāgata is boundless; peerless in the world and unattached, his compassionate mind manifests universally before all beings. The deity of Vast Renown has awakened to this path.

In the past, when the Buddha was practicing the conduct for enlightenment, he made vows before every single one of all the Buddhas of the ten directions; hearing this, Suvarṇaprabhāsa was filled with great joy.
Furthermore, the Brahma King Śikhin attained universal abiding within the sites of enlightenment throughout the ten directions and preached the Dharma, his conduct being pure.
The Brahma King Pure and Untainted Attainment entered the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to enter dhyāna-samādhi and abide therein.
The Brahma King Radiance of Good Wisdom entered the liberation door of universally entering all inconceivable dharmas.
The Brahma King Universal Cloud Sound entered the liberation door of penetrating the ocean of all the Buddhas' voices.

The Gate: The Brahma King Sovereign over the Sounds of the World’s Speech attained the liberation door of being able to recollect the skillful means by which Bodhisattvas teach and transform all sentient beings.
The Brahma King Eye of Tranquil Radiance attained the liberation door of manifesting the distinct characteristics of the karmic retributions of all worlds.
The Brahma King Universal Radiance attained [the liberation door] that accords with the categories of all sentient beings.
The Brahma King *Sarvasadṛśavibhāgapratyutpannavinayamukha* attained the liberation door of the realm of the practice of quiescence, which is the pure characteristic of all phenomena.

The Brahma King *Prabhāsaśobhana* attained the liberation door of constantly and diligently appearing without attachment to all that exists, being boundless and without dependence. The Brahma King *Manojña*... [attained] the liberation door of... [pleasing].
The Brahma King Ocean Sound attained the liberation door of constantly contemplating and observing the inexhaustible Dharma. At that time, the Great Brahma King Śikhin,
empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the assemblies of the Brahmakāyika, Brahmapurohita, Brahmakāyika,
and Mahābrahmā devas, and spoke in verse:
The Buddha’s body is pure and eternally quiescent; Its radiance shines throughout the world.
Without marks, without activity, and without reflection, Like the sky or clouds, thus one sees the Buddha’s body.
Such is the realm of meditative concentration, Which no sentient beings can fathom.
He reveals to them inconceivable gates of skillful means; this is the liberation of the King of Wisdom Light, who has realized an ocean of Dharma-gates as numerous as the atoms within a Buddha-field.

To expound them in a single word is to exhaust them without remainder, yet even throughout oceans of eons, such an exposition would never be exhausted. This is the liberation of the Well-Considered Wisdom Light.
The perfect voices of all Buddhas are equal to the world; Sentient beings each attain understanding according to their kind, yet within those sounds there is no discrimination.
The Universal Sound Brahmā realized this, and thus entered the skillful practices for attaining Bodhi of all Tathāgatas throughout the three periods of time.
All things appear within the Buddha’s body; The diverse karmas of all sentient beings from times past,
And their various differences according to the causes they have invoked—
The World-Honored One manifests all these accordingly, And the deity Śāntiprabha is able to awaken to and enter them.
Mastery over all immeasurable Dharma gates, Taming sentient beings throughout the ten directions,
Yet never giving rise to discrimination therein— This is the realm of Samantaprabha. The Buddha-body is like space,
inexhaustible, Signless and unimpeded, pervading the ten directions.
All manifestations are like illusions; The King of Transformed Sounds realized this path.
The physical marks of the Tathāgata’s body are boundless, And his wisdom and voice are likewise so.
Appearing in forms within the world without attachment— The Celestial King Radiant Light enters this gate.
The Dharma King dwells securely in the palace of the sublime Dharma; The radiance of his Dharma-body shines everywhere without exception.
The Dharma-body is peerless and devoid of all marks; This is the liberation of King Ocean-Sound.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Sovereign obtained the liberation of the "Sovereign Treasury that Ripens Immeasurable Beings Before One’s Eyes."
The Gate of the Celestial King Sudarśana: attaining the liberation door of observing the happiness of all sentient beings and causing them to enter the bliss of the noble realm.
The Celestial King Ratnaketu-mukuṭa: attaining the liberation door of arising practice in accordance with the various desires and understandings of all sentient beings.
The Celestial King Vīramati: attaining the liberation door of universally encompassing the meaning of what is taught for the sake of all sentient beings.
The Gate of Liberation: The Celestial King Sublime Sound obtains the gate of liberation for advancing one’s own practice through mindfulness of the Tathāgata’s vast compassion.
The Celestial King Banner of Wondrous Light obtains the gate of liberation for manifesting the door of great compassion to destroy all banners of pride.
The Celestial King Realm of Tranquility obtains the gate of liberation for subduing all worldly minds of malice and harm.
The liberation door of the Celestial King Banner Adorned with Wondrous Wheels, who attains the liberation door of all Buddhas of the ten directions coming to his presence whenever he recollects them;

the liberation door of the Celestial King Flower-Light Wisdom, who attains the liberation door of universally manifesting the attainment of perfect enlightenment in accordance with the mental inclinations of sentient beings;
and the liberation door of the Celestial King Indra-Wondrous Light, who attains the great majesty that universally enters all worlds.

The Dharma Door of Liberation through Mastery over Power. At that time, the Celestial King Īśvara, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed all the hosts of the Īśvara devas and spoke in verse:
The Buddha’s body is all-pervasive, equal to the Dharma-realm;

Appearing before all sentient beings in accordance with their needs, He constantly transforms and guides them through various gates of teaching. Masterful in the Dharma, he is able to bring about awakening;
Of all the various pleasures existing in the world, The noble bliss of cessation is the most supreme.
Abiding within the vast nature of phenomena, the Celestial King Subtle Eye beholds this Tathāgata appearing throughout the ten directions;
responding universally to the minds of all beings, he preaches the Dharma and severs all doubts and suspicions—
this is the liberation door of the "Sublime Banner Crown."
The Buddhas throughout the world proclaim wondrous sounds;
The teachings they have expounded over immeasurable eons They can fully express in a single word.
The liberation of the courageous and wise Deva, And the vast compassion he possesses toward the world, Are not equal to even a single hair’s breadth Of the Tathāgata.
The Buddha’s compassion is like space, inexhaustible; This is what the deva Subhāṣitaghoṣa has attained.
The high mountains of pride in all sentient beings— The One of Ten Powers crushes them entirely without remainder.
This is the application of the Tathāgata’s great compassion, The path traversed by the king Prabhāketudhvaja.
The light of wisdom is pure and fills the world; whoever beholds it is freed from the darkness of delusion and led far away from all evil paths.
The Celestial King Śāntideva, having realized this Dharma, can proclaim through the radiance of his pores the names of Buddhas as numerous as all sentient beings.
According to their inclinations, all hear it; this liberation of the Wondrous Wheel Banner is the sovereign power of the Tathāgata, immeasurable.
It fills the entire dharma-realm and empty space, and all assemblies clearly behold it;
this gate of liberation is entered by Flower Wisdom.
Throughout oceans of immeasurable and boundless great eons, he universally appears throughout the ten directions to preach the Dharma;
yet no deity has ever been seen to come or go—this is what the Celestial King Subtle Light has realized.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Skillful Transformation attained the liberation door of "Revealing the Power of Transforming All Karmas. It is tranquil.
The Celestial King Sound-Light attained the liberation door of relinquishing all攀緣 (pān-yuán, objective attachments).

The Celestial King Transformation-Power-Light attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the ignorant darkness of the minds of all sentient beings, causing their wisdom to be perfected.
The Celestial King Lord of Adornment attained the liberation door of manifesting infinite, pleasing sounds.
The Celestial King Light of Mindfulness attained the liberation door of knowing the inexhaustible marks of the merit of all Buddhas.

The Celestial King Supreme Cloud Sound attained the liberation door of universally knowing the sequence of the formation and destruction of all past eons. The Celestial King Victorious Light attained...

The Celestial King Awakening All Sentient Beings attained the liberation door of wisdom and deliverance. The Celestial King Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of emitting light that swiftly fills the void realms of the ten directions.
The Celestial King Joyful Wisdom attained the liberation door of the power of diligence that cannot be destroyed by anything done.
The Celestial King Flower Light Topknot attained the liberation door of knowing the retributions received for all the karmic actions of sentient beings.
The Gate of Liberation: Universally Beholding the Manifestation of the Inconceivable Diversity of Forms and Species of Sentient Beings by the Heavenly King of the Ten Directions.
At that time, the Heavenly King Skillful Transformation, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of the Heaven of Skillful Transformation and spoke in verse:
The nature of karma in the world is inconceivable; for the sake of the deluded masses, the Buddha has fully revealed it.
He skillfully explains the true principle of causes and conditions:
that the various differentiated karmas of all sentient beings, when one contemplates the Buddha, are found to be non-existent, and cannot be apprehended even if sought throughout the ten directions.
The Dharma-body manifests without reality; this is what the Silent Sound of Dharma has seen.
The Buddha cultivated all practices throughout oceans of eons, In order to extinguish the delusions and darkness of ignorance in the world.
Therefore, he is pure and most brilliantly illuminating; This is what the Mind of Radiant Power has realized.
Whatever wondrous sounds exist in the world, none can compare to the voice of the Tathāgata;
with a single sound, the Buddha pervades the ten directions.
O Lord of Adornment, who has entered this liberation, all the power of merit possessed by all beings in the world does not equal even a single attribute of the Tathāgata.
The Tathāgata’s merit is equal to space, as perceived by the Deva Light of Mindfulness;
all the infinite eons of the three periods of time, with their various signs of formation and decay,
the Buddha can manifest within a single pore, as understood by the Devas of Supreme Cloud-Sound.
The empty space of the ten directions may be measured, But the measure of a single pore of the Buddha cannot be found.
Thus, this unimpeded and inconceivable state, King Wondrous Topknot has already realized.
Throughout immeasurable kalpas in past ages, The Buddha fully cultivated the vast pāramitās.
Diligently practicing with vigor, without weariness or indolence, With joyful wisdom, one can know that the nature of this Dharma-gate’s karma and its causal conditions are inconceivable.
The Buddha, for the sake of the world, expounds that the nature of phenomena is fundamentally pure and free from all defilements; This is the point of entry for Flower Radiance.
"You should observe that within a single pore of the Buddha, all sentient beings are fully contained;
yet they neither come nor go—this is what King Universal Vision has realized.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Contented with Knowledge attained the liberation door of understanding the perfect wheel of teachings for the appearance of all Buddhas in the world.
The Celestial King Joyful Ocean-Ushnisha attained the liberation door of a body of pure radiance that exhausts the realm of empty space.
The Celestial King Banner of Supreme Virtue attained the liberation door of a sea of pure vows that extinguishes the suffering of the world.
The Celestial King Tranquil Light attained the liberation door of manifesting bodies everywhere to preach the Dharma. The Celestial King Good Eyes attained the universal purification of one...
The Celestial King Jewel Peak Moon attained the liberation door of the inexhaustible treasury that universally transforms the world and is ever-present.
The Celestial King Valiant Power attained the liberation door of revealing the realm of the perfect awakening of all Buddhas.
The Celestial King Vajra Sublime Light attained the liberation door of solidifying the bodhicitta of all sentient beings.

[He attained] the liberation door of the indestructible. The Celestial King Constellation Banner attained the liberation door of skillful means for approaching, observing, and taming all sentient beings whenever any Buddha appears in the world.

The Celestial King Sublime Adornment attained the liberation door of knowing the minds of all sentient beings in a single thought-moment and manifesting in response according to their capacities. At that time, the Celestial King Contentment, receiving from the Buddha...
With great majesty, he surveyed all the hosts of the gods of the Heaven of Universal Purity and spoke these verses:
"The Tathāgata is vast and pervades the entire Dharma-realm; Toward all sentient beings, he is entirely impartial.
Universally responding to the inclinations of the multitudes, he reveals the wondrous gateways, Causing them to enter the inconceivable, pure Dharma."
The Buddha’s body appears universally throughout the ten directions;
Unattached, unimpeded, and beyond grasping, its various forms and images are seen by all the world. This is the realm entered by the goddess Priyamukha:
In the past, the Tathāgata cultivated all practices, His pure great vows as deep as the ocean.
Bringing all Buddha-dharmas to full completion— The Victorious One, possessing supreme virtue, knows this skillful means.
The Tathāgata’s Dharma-body is inconceivable; Like reflections manifesting forms, it pervades the entire Dharma-realm, Expounding and clarifying all dharmas everywhere.
This is the liberation gate of the deity Śāntiprabha.
Sentient beings are entangled and shrouded by karma and delusion; their pride and negligence cause their minds to wander restlessly.
The Tathāgata preaches the Dharma of tranquility for them; with his excellent eyes he illuminates their hearts, and they rejoice.
The true guide of all worlds has appeared as a savior and a refuge.
Universally showing sentient beings the place of peace and bliss, Fengyue is able to enter deeply here into the inconceivable realm of all Buddhas;
Pervading the entire dharma-realm and reaching the other shore of all dharmas, Yonghui beholds this and gives rise to joy.
If there are sentient beings capable of being transformed, who hear of the Buddha’s merits and proceed toward Bodhi,
causing them to abide in the ocean of blessings and remain ever pure— wondrous light can observe these,
reaching and gathering at all the abodes of the Buddhas throughout as many oceans of lands as there are atoms in ten directions.
Reverently making offerings and listening to the Dharma—this is what the sentient beings see within the inconceivable ocean of minds of Adorned Banner.
Without abiding, without movement, and without a place of reliance, the Buddha clearly manifests in a single thought-moment; the Deva Sublime Adornment understands this well.
Furthermore, the Celestial King Timing obtained the liberation door of initiating the roots of goodness in all sentient beings and causing them to forever leave behind sorrow and affliction.
The Celestial King Sublime Light obtained the liberation door of universally entering all realms.

The Celestial King Banner of Inexhaustible Wisdom and Merit obtained the liberation door of the great compassion wheel that extinguishes and removes all ailments. The Celestial King Skillful Transformation... [End of fragment]
The Celestial King Gāndhārī attained the liberation door of knowing the minds of all sentient beings throughout the three periods of time.
The Celestial King Mahāprabhāsa-dhāraṇī attained the liberation door of the light of dhāraṇīs that recollects and maintains all dharmas without forgetfulness.
The Celestial King Acintya-prajñā attained the inconceivable skillful means of skillfully entering the self-nature of all karma.
The Gate of Liberation: The Celestial King Nābhi-cakra attained the gate of liberation consisting of the skillful means of turning the wheel of Dharma to bring sentient beings to maturity.
The Celestial King Arciṣmān attained the gate of liberation of observing all sentient beings with vast eyes and proceeding to tame them.
The Celestial King Prabhāsa attained the gate of liberation of transcending all karmic obstacles and not following the deeds of Māra. Universal Observation...

Having observed the celestial king Mahāyaśas attaining the liberation door of purifying the mind through skillfully exhorting all the hosts of devas so that they may accept and practice [the teachings],
the celestial king Kāla, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority,
surveyed the entire assembly of the Kāla devas and spoke these verses:
Throughout immeasurable and long-extended kalpas, the Buddha has exhausted the ocean of worldly sorrow and affliction;
he has widely opened the pure path free from dust and forever illumined the lamp of wisdom for all sentient beings.
The Tathāgata’s Dharma-body is exceedingly vast and great; its boundaries cannot be found throughout the ten directions.
All skillful means are immeasurable; the wisdom of the Radiant and Wondrous Light can enter them.
Birth, old age, sickness, death, sorrow, grief, and suffering oppress the world without ceasing for even a moment.
The Great Teacher, out of compassion, vows to eliminate them all; with the light of inexhaustible wisdom, he is able to awaken to and understand them.
The Buddha’s illusory-like wisdom is unimpeded; He fully comprehends all phenomena across the three periods of time.

Universally entering into the mental activities of sentient beings— This realm of the Skillful Transformation Deva is such that the limits of its dhāraṇī cannot be found, And the ocean of his eloquence is likewise inexhaustible.
Able to turn the pure and wondrous wheel of Dharma—this is the nature of the liberation of Great Radiance, vast and inexhaustible.
With wisdom and awakening, he skillfully reveals all inconceivable expedient means; such is the entry of Wisdom Heaven.
Turning the inconceivable, wondrous wheel of Dharma, Revealing the cultivation of the path to Bodhi,
Permanently extinguishing all suffering of sentient beings— This is the stage of skillful means at the hub of the wheel;
The Tathāgata’s true body is fundamentally non-dual, Manifesting according to objects and following forms to fill the world.
Sentient beings each appear before him; this is the realm of the Lord of the Flame Heaven.
If there are sentient beings who behold the Buddha even once, he will surely cause them to purify all karmic obstructions;
having forever eliminated all demonic activities without exception, his light shines upon the path traversed by the Heavenly King.
In this vast ocean-like assembly of all beings, the Buddha shines with supreme majesty;
he universally rains down the rain of Dharma to nourish all living creatures. This is the liberation door named "Entry.
Furthermore, the celestial king Śakrendra attained the recollection of the appearance of Buddhas throughout the three periods of time, extending even to the lands.
The Celestial King Great Joy from Clearly Perceiving Both Formation and Destruction attained the liberation door of "Great Joy through Clear Vision.
The Celestial King Universal Sound of Pervasive Fame attained the liberation door of "Causing the Buddha’s Form Body to be Utterly Pure and Vast, Peerless in the World.

The Celestial King Jewel Light Banner of Renown attained the liberation door of "Universal Coverage by Clouds of Compassion. The Celestial King Jewel Light Banner of Renown attained the liberation door of "Constantly Beholding the Buddha."
The Celestial King Various Manifestations of Form and Majestic Virtue before All World Rulers attained the liberation door of manifesting bodies of various forms and majestic virtues.
The Celestial King Topknot Producing Joy and Bliss attained the liberation door of knowing from what meritorious karma all sentient beings' cities and palaces arise.
The Celestial King Upright Mindfulness attained the liberation door of revealing the deeds of all Buddhas in maturing sentient beings.
The Celestial King Exalted Sound attained the liberation door of knowing the signs of transformation during all the kalpas of formation and destruction of the worlds.
The Celestial King Accomplished Mindfulness attained the liberation door of recollecting the future practices of Bodhisattvas for the sake of taming sentient beings.
The Celestial King Pure Flower Radiance attained the liberation door of thoroughly understanding the causes of the happiness of all devas.
The Celestial King Wisdom Sun Eye attained the liberation door of revealing the roots of goodness for the rebirth of all devaputras so that they may be free from delusion and confusion.
The Celestial King Sovereign Light attained the liberation door of awakening all the hosts of devas, causing them to forever sever the seeds [of affliction].

The Gate of Liberation through Resolving All Doubts. At that time, Śakrendra, the Heavenly King, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed all the hosts of the Trāyastriṃśa Heaven and spoke in verse:
I recollect all Buddhas of the three periods of time; All their realms are entirely equal.
Just as their lands are destroyed and formed, Through the Buddha’s majestic spiritual power, they are all seen.
The Buddha-body is vast, pervading the ten directions; Its wondrous form is peerless, surpassing all living beings.
The radiance of his light shines everywhere without exception;
this path is universally praised as the ability to behold the Tathāgata’s ocean of skillful means and great compassion.
Having practiced with ultimate purity throughout past eons, he guides and transforms sentient beings without limit; the Celestial King Ratnaśikhin has realized this.
As I contemplate the ocean of merits of the Dharma King, peerless and supreme among all in the world, a vast heart of joy arises within me.
This liberation of the Deva Jewel-Light is known by the Buddha;
he perceives the ocean of sentient beings' virtuous karma and the great merit born from various superior causes.
All these are made to appear without exception; this is what the deity Joy-Knot perceives:
the appearance of Buddhas throughout the ten directions, who pervade all worlds and, observing the minds of sentient beings, demonstrate the means of their discipline.
The Heavenly King Right Mindfulness has realized this path.
The Tathāgata’s wisdom-body and vast eye see even the subtlest atoms within all worlds;
thus they pervade the ten directions. This liberation of the Cloud-Sound Heaven King—the bodhisattva practices of all Buddha-sons—is fully manifested by the Tathāgata within every single pore.
Just as they are immeasurable and fully complete, so too does this King of Mindfulness clearly perceive all matters of peace and happiness in the world;
all these arise from the Buddha, for the Tathāgata’s merit is supreme and peerless. Into this state of liberation, Flower King has entered.
If one recollects even a small virtue of the Tathāgata, Even for a single thought-moment, with a mind focused and yearning, The terrors of the evil realms will be forever eliminated.
With the eye of wisdom, one can deeply awaken here to the great spiritual powers within the dharma of quiescence;
Universally responding to the minds of all beings, there is nowhere it does not reach.

All doubts are completely severed. This is the liberation door attained by King of Radiance, wherein he universally illuminates the sentient beings of the ten directions with pure light throughout all future kalpas, constantly acting for their benefit.

Furthermore, the Devaputra Sunlight attains the liberation door of constant benefit through universal illumination. The Devaputra Flaming Eyes attains the liberation door of awakening all beings through bodies that manifest according to their respective types.
The Devaputra Jāti-jñāna-sāgara-praveśa attained the liberation door of causing beings to enter the ocean of wisdom.
The Devaputra Sumeru-prabha-nandadhvaja attained the liberation door of acting as a master for all sentient beings to cause them to diligently cultivate boundless pure merits.
The Devaputra Vimala-ratnacandra attained the liberation door of cultivating all ascetic practices with a heart of profound joy. The Devaputra Śūra-vīryāvinivartin...
The Son of Heaven named Unobstructed Light Shining Universally attained the liberation door of benefiting the vital spirits of all sentient beings and causing them to attain liberation.

The Son of Heaven named Light of the Wondrous Flower Garland attained the liberation door of pure light shining universally upon the bodies of sentient beings, causing them to give rise to joy and an ocean of faith and understanding.
The Son of Heaven named Light of the Supreme Victory Banner attained the liberation door of light shining universally upon all worlds, causing...
The Devaputra Variegated Array of Exquisite Virtues attained the liberation door of accomplishing various sublime merits.
The Devaputra Jewel-Crest Universal Radiance attained the liberation door of the ocean of great compassion manifesting infinite realms and various jewel-like forms and signs.

The Devaputra Eye of Radiance attained the liberation door of purifying the eyes of all sentient beings so that they may see the treasury of the Dharma-realm. The Devaputra Sustainer of Virtue attained...
The Celestial Son Light of Universal Movement attained the liberation door of generating a pure,
continuous mind that prevents the destruction of liberation. At that time, the Sun Deity,
empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed the entire assembly of sun deities.
And he spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata’s vast light of wisdom Universally illumines all lands in the ten directions;
All sentient beings behold the Buddha, Through manifold skillful means for their subduing.
The Tathāgata’s physical marks are boundless;
According to their inclinations, he manifests his body everywhere, Universally opening the ocean of wisdom for the world. Thus does Flame-Eye contemplate the Buddha:
The Buddha-body is peerless and beyond compare, Its radiance shining throughout the ten directions.
Surpassing all, most unsurpassed—this Dharma gate was joyfully attained for the benefit of the world.
Having practiced asceticism for immeasurable eons throughout the cycles of existence, its light is as pervasive and pure as space;
the Jewel Moon is able to know this skillful means.
The Buddha proclaims wondrous sounds without obstruction, pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
with the flavor of the Dharma, he benefits all living beings. With courage, he is able to know these skillful means, emitting inconceivable nets of light that universally purify all sentient beings.
Causing all to give rise to profound faith and understanding—this is the gateway of the Flower-Garland Devas.
All the lights existing in the world do not equal the light from a single pore of the Buddha;
such is the inconceivable radiance of the Buddha. This is the liberation of the Light of the Supreme Banner.
The Dharma of all Buddhas is thus: seated beneath the sovereign Bodhi tree, they cause those who follow non-ways to abide in the Way.
With the light of the Jewel-Crest, they see sentient beings suffering in blindness, darkness, and folly; the Buddha desires to cause them to give birth to the pure eye.
Therefore, he kindles the lamp of wisdom; The Lord of Sovereign Skillful Means, with virtuous eyes, observes this deeply.
If there are those who have once seen him and made offerings, He causes them all to practice until they reach the fruit. This is the power of the skillful means of the Virtuous Deity (Guṇadeva).
Within a single dharma-gate there are immeasurable gates; Thus they have been expounded for immeasurable thousands of kalpas.
The vast meaning of the dharma-gates thus proclaimed Is fully realized by the Devaputra Universal Radiance.
Furthermore, the Moon Devaputra attained the liberation gate of "Pure Light Universally Illuminating the Dharma Realm to Gather and Transform Sentient Beings. Flower.
The Celestial Son King of Radiant Topknot attained the liberation door of observing all realms of sentient beings and causing them to universally enter the infinite Dharma.
The Celestial Son of Various Wondrous Pure Light attained the liberation door of knowing the various objects of attachment and the movements within the ocean of the minds of all sentient beings.
The Celestial Son of a Mind that Brings Peace and Joy to the World attained [the liberation door] of bestowing upon all sentient beings...
The liberation door of causing great joy and exultation through inconceivable bliss;

and the liberation door attained by the Devaputra named Tree-King Eye-Light, who, like a farmer tending his crops, protects the seeds, sprouts, and stalks according to the seasons so that they reach fulfillment.
The Celestial Son Pure Radiance attained the liberation door of manifesting compassionate protection for all sentient beings, causing them to clearly perceive the experiences of suffering and joy.
The Celestial Son Universal Traveler Immutable Light attained the liberation door of being able to uphold the pure moon and universally observing the ten directions.
The Celestial Son Sovereign King of Constellations attained the liberation door of revealing that all phenomena are like [reflections].
The Devaputra Moon-like Illusion attained the liberation door of being signless and devoid of self-nature like empty space.

The Devaputra Pure Awakening Moon attained the liberation door of universally initiating great karmic activities for the sake of all sentient beings. The Devaputra Light of Great Majestic Virtue attained the liberation door of universally severing all doubts and delusions.
At that time, the Devaputra Moon, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed everywhere.
Within the assembly of devas in the palace of the Candra-maṇḍala, he spoke these verses:
The Buddha emits radiance that pervades the world, Illuminating all lands throughout the ten directions;
He expounds the inconceivable and vast Dharma, Forever shattering the darkness of sentient beings' delusion.

The realms are boundless and inexhaustible; throughout immeasurable eons, you constantly guide and instruct, manifesting various sovereign transformations for all living beings. Thus does Flower-Tuft observe the Buddha:
the ocean of sentient beings' minds differs from moment to moment, yet the Buddha’s wisdom is vast and wide, knowing them all completely.
Universally preaching the Dharma to bring joy to all, this wondrous radiance liberates sentient beings;
for those who lack noble peace and happiness, who are mired in evil realms and undergo various sufferings,
the Tathāgata reveals the gateway of the nature of phenomena (dharmatā), so that they may contemplate with peace and see thus.

The Tathāgata’s rare and great compassion, for the benefit of sentient beings, enters into all realms of existence to preach the Dharma, exhorting them toward virtue so that they may achieve accomplishment; this is what the deva Cakṣuṣmanta understands.
The World-Honored One has revealed the radiance of the Dharma, discerning the nature of all worldly karmas.
The deeds of good and evil are never lost; Pure Light beholds this and gives rise to joy.

The Buddha is the foundation for all merit; like the great earth that supports all dwellings, he skillfully shows the path of peace and security free from sorrow. He is immovable and can know these skillful means.
The great brilliance of the fire of wisdom pervades the Dharma-realm;
manifesting in countless forms equal to all sentient beings, it universally reveals the truth to all. The Star-King Deva realized this path:
that the Buddha is like space, devoid of self-nature, yet manifests in the world for the benefit of sentient beings.
Adorned with the marks and signs like a reflected image, the King of the Heaven of Pure Awakening sees the Buddha’s body thus;
from every pore, sounds are universally proclaimed, and the clouds of Dharma cover the world without exception,
such that all who hear them cannot fail to give rise to joy— thus does the Deva of Light of Liberation awaken.

Essential Outline of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha, Volume Three.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda, a Śramaṇa from the Kingdom of Khotan.
Commentary on the Meaning by the Śramaṇa Chengguan of Qingliangshan Dàhuá yán Sī;

Chapter One: The Sublime Array of World Rulers, Part Three.
Furthermore, the Gandharva King Dhṛtarāṣṭra attained the liberation door of sovereign skillful means for gathering all sentient beings.
The Gandharva King Vṛkṣaprabha attained the liberation door of universally beholding the adornments of all merits.
The Gandharva King Viśuddhanetra attained the liberation door of forever severing the sorrow and suffering of all sentient beings and giving rise to a treasury of joy.
The Gandharva King Flower-Crown attained the liberation door of eternally severing the delusions of false views in all sentient beings.
The Gandharva King Joyful Steps and Universal Sound attained the liberation door of spreading widely like clouds to universally shade and nourish all sentient beings.
The Gandharva King Delightful Shaking Beautiful Eyes attained the liberation door of manifesting a vast, wondrous, and excellent body.
The Gandharva King Lion Banner of Sublime Sound attained the liberation door of universally scattering all great names and reputations throughout the ten directions.
The Gandharva King Universal Radiance of Jewel Light attained the liberation door of manifesting a pure body of light that brings universal great joy. The [Gandharva King] Diamond Tree Flower...
The Gandharva King Dhvajavyūha attained the liberation door of universally nourishing and flourishing all trees so that all who see them experience joy.
The Gandharva King Samantavyūhapratiṣṭhita attained the liberation door of skillfully entering the realm of all Buddhas and bestowing peace and happiness upon sentient beings.
At that time, the Gandharva King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, surveyed everything.
The host of gandharvas spoke in verse:
“The realm of the Buddhas has infinite gateways, which no sentient beings are able to enter.
The Sugata is pure like the nature of space, universally opening the right path for the world.”
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, The great oceans of merit are completely filled;
All worlds are brought to benefit and joy— This is what King Druma-prabha is able to see.
The vast ocean of sorrow and suffering in the world, The Buddha can exhaust and dry up entirely, leaving nothing behind.
The Tathāgata’s compassion and manifold skillful means— The Pure-Eyed One can deeply understand these here.
The oceans of lands in the ten directions are boundless; The Buddha, with the light of wisdom, illuminates them all, Causing all evil and perverted views to be thoroughly cleansed away.
This is the entrance through which the King of Tree-Flowers has entered.
In the past, throughout immeasurable eons, the Buddha practiced the skillful means of great compassion, bringing comfort and peace to all worlds.
This path, Samantaghoṣa, you are able to awaken to and enter;
the Buddha-body is pure and all delight in seeing it, for it can produce inexhaustible happiness in the world.
The sequence of cause and effect for liberation is thus accomplished; With beautiful eyes, he skillfully reveals this to sentient beings.
Those who wander perpetually in delusion, Their veils of ignorance being extremely firm and dense— For them the Tathāgata preaches the vast Dharma; King Siṃhadhvaja is able to expound it clearly.
The Tathāgata universally manifests a wondrous form-body, With infinite distinctions, equal to the various kinds of sentient beings;
Through various skillful means, he illuminates the world.
With such wondrous sounds, he contemplates the Buddha’s gateways of great wisdom and skillful means, which are immeasurable; For the sake of all living beings, the Buddha universally expounds them.
Entering the true practice of supreme enlightenment,
this Vajradhvaja well observes a hundred thousand eons within a single instant; by the power of the Buddha, he can manifest without wavering,
bestowing peace and happiness upon all beings— this is the liberation of "Adornment of Bliss."
Furthermore, the Gūḍharāja Kumbhāṇḍa King attained the liberation door of the power to extinguish all enmity and harm;
the Nāgendra Kumbhāṇḍa King attained the liberation door of the ocean of gates for practicing boundless conduct;
the Vyūhadhvaja Kumbhāṇḍa King attained the liberation door of knowing the inclinations of the minds of all sentient beings; and the Upakārakriyā Kumbhāṇḍa...
King Prāptasamantasaṃpattiviśuddhamahāprabhākarmakṛt attained the liberation door of performing deeds through the great light of universal accomplishment.
Bhīṣaṇa, the Kumbhāṇḍa King, attained the liberation door of revealing the path of peace and fearlessness for all sentient beings.
Suvyūha, the Kumbhāṇḍa King, attained the liberation door of exhausting and drying up the ocean of craving and desire of all sentient beings. Śikharadhara...
The Gubhāṇḍa King Prajñā attained the liberation door of the light-cloud that universally manifests in all realms of existence.
The Gubhāṇḍa King Śūrabāhu attained the liberation door of universally emitting light to extinguish heavy obstructions as massive as mountains.
The Gubhāṇḍa King Anantaviśuddhapuṣpanetra attained the liberation door of revealing the treasury of non-regressing great compassion. The Gubhāṇḍa King Vipulavaktra...
The Kumbhāṇḍa King attained the liberation door of universally manifesting bodies that flow through all realms of existence.
At that time, the Kumbhāṇḍa King Vardhana, sustained by the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of kumbhāṇḍas and spoke in verse:
The World-Leader who has perfected the power of patience, For the sake of sentient beings, practiced for immeasurable eons;
Forever free from worldly pride and delusion, Therefore his body is most majestic and pure.
In the past, the Buddha universally cultivated an ocean of all practices, To transform and guide immeasurable multitudes throughout the ten directions.
Through various skillful means, he benefits all living beings;
This gate of liberation was attained by the Dragon King Buddha, who with great wisdom rescues sentient beings. There are none whose minds he does not clearly know;
With manifold sovereign powers, he tames them all. Seeing this, Adorned Banner felt great joy.
The manifestation of the Way of the Gods is like light and shadow; The true Dharma-wheel is identical to empty space.
Thus dwelling in the world for immeasurable kalpas, This is what King Ānanda has realized:
Sentient beings are constantly deluded by the cataracts of ignorance; The Buddha’s radiance illuminates and reveals the path of peace.
To provide protection and cause suffering to be removed—those who can contemplate this dharma-gate see that those drifting and sinking in the ocean of desire possess manifold sufferings.
When the light of wisdom shines universally, these are extinguished without remainder;
once suffering has been eliminated, he preaches the Dharma for them. This is what the Wondrously Adorned One has realized.
The Buddha’s body universally responds, so that there is nowhere it is not seen; Through various skillful means, he transforms all living beings.
His voice thunders like a clap of thunder, raining down the rain of Dharma; Into such a Dharma gate does Noble Wisdom enter.
Pure and radiant light does not arise in vain; Should one encounter it, it will surely cause heavy obstacles to be dissolved.
He manifests the boundless virtues of the Buddha; The Heroic Arm can clarify this profound principle.

Desiring to bring peace and happiness to all sentient beings, He has cultivated great compassion for immeasurable eons, Using various skillful means to eliminate the manifold sufferings— Such is what the Pure Flower beholds.

With sovereign and inconceivable supernormal powers, his body manifests universally throughout the ten directions, yet amidst all things he neither comes nor goes; this is what King Viśālamukha has realized.
Furthermore, the Dragon King Virūpākṣa has attained the liberation that extinguishes the blazing sufferings of all the dragon realms.
The Dragon King Sāgara attained the liberation door of transforming his own dragon form within a single thought-moment to manifest the bodies of immeasurable sentient beings.

The Dragon King Meghasvaradhvaja attained the liberation door of proclaiming the ocean of the Buddha’s boundless names with a pure voice throughout all realms of existence. The Dragon King Jvalanāmukha attained the universal manifestation of...
The Dragon King Flame-Eye attained the liberation door of establishing distinctions throughout all Buddha-worlds.

The Dragon King Cloud-Pinnacle attained the liberation door of revealing to all sentient beings the ocean of merit and great joy. The Dragon King Takṣaka attained... [the liberation door of] the Tathāgata’s compassion that causes the coverings and entanglements of anger and delusion in all sentient beings to be extinguished.
The Dragon King Pure Rescue Sound attained the liberation door of extinguishing all fears.
The Dragon King Boundless Steps attained the liberation door of manifesting the physical bodies of all Buddhas and the sequence of abiding kalpas.
The Dragon King Swift Pure Color attained the liberation door of giving rise to an ocean of great love, joy, and delight for all sentient beings. Universally...
The Dragon King Great Sound attained the liberation door of manifesting all-pervasive, harmonious, and unimpeded sounds;
the Dragon King Without Heat attained the liberation door of extinguishing all suffering in the world with clouds of great compassion that universally cover it.
At that time, the Dragon King Virūpākṣa, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of dragons.
Having spoken thus, he uttered these verses:
"Behold, the Dharma of the Tathāgata is ever thus: It brings benefit to all sentient beings.
By the power of great compassion and pity, He pulls out those who have fallen into the perilous paths."
The various distinctions of all sentient beings are all manifested within a single hair-tip;

supernatural transformations fill the world. Sāgaramati thus contemplates the Buddha, who, by the power of his infinite supernatural faculties, extensively proclaims names equal in number to all sentient beings.
According to their inclinations, he causes them all to hear; such cloud-like sounds enable those in immeasurable and boundless lands to awaken and understand.
The Buddha can cause them all to enter a single pore, where the Tathāgata sits peacefully amidst that assembly—this is what the dragon *Jvālāmukha* beheld.
The hearts of all sentient beings, bound by anger and shrouded in ignorance as deep as the ocean,
are all extinguished through the Tathāgata’s compassion; the Dragon of Flames beholds this clearly,
and the power of the merit of all sentient beings is manifested within every pore of the Buddha.
Having already caused them to return to the great ocean of merit, this Cloud Banner of Height contemplates the Buddha’s body;
from its pores issues forth the light of wisdom, and that light everywhere proclaims wondrous sounds,
so that sentient beings who hear it are freed from sorrow and fear— the Dragon Takṣaka has awakened to this path.
The lands, adornments, and successive eons of all Tathāgatas of the three periods of time—
all these appear within the body of the Buddha. Having witnessed this power of spiritual transformation,
I contemplate the Tathāgata’s past conduct and behold the ocean of offerings made to all Buddhas.
All there increase their hearts of joy and delight; this is the entry of the Swift Dragon.
The Buddha, through skillful means and voices adapted to each kind, preaches the Dharma for the assembly to bring them joy.
His voice is pure and elegant, pleasing to all; those who hear it everywhere awaken with glad hearts.
Sentient beings are oppressed within the various realms of existence, drifting and turning through karma and afflictions with no one to save them;
the Buddha, through great compassion, causes them to attain liberation—this is what the Great Dragon Anāthapiṇḍada can realize.
Furthermore, the Yakṣa King Vaiśravaṇa, by means of boundless expedient means, protects and delivers evil sentient beings.
The Yakṣa King Vimuktidvāra attained the liberation door of universally observing sentient beings with skillful means to provide their rescue and protection.
The Yakṣa King Vyūhitaśastra attained the liberation door of being able to sustain and benefit all extremely weak and wicked sentient beings.
The Yakṣa King Mahājñāna attained the liberation door of extolling the ocean of merits of all the sages.
The Yakṣa King Jvālākṣa attained the liberation door of the great compassionate wisdom that universally observes all sentient beings.
The Yakṣa King Vajrākṣa attained the liberation door of various skillful means to benefit and bring peace and happiness to all sentient beings.
The Yakṣa King Vikramabāhu attained the liberation door of universally entering into the meaning of all dharmas. The Yakṣa King Śūra...
The Yakṣa King Arisen from the Great Army attained the liberation door of protecting all sentient beings so that they abide on the Path, ensuring none pass through it in vain.
The Yakṣa King Abundant Wealth attained the liberation door of increasing the mass of merit for all sentient beings so that they constantly experience happiness.
The Yakṣa King Power Destroying High Mountains attained the liberation door of recollecting [the Buddha] in accordance with his presence.
The liberation door of the light of wisdom born from the power of the Buddha.
At that time, the Great Yakṣa King Bahuruta, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of yakṣas and spoke these verses:
Sentient beings’ transgressions are so profound they are terrifying;
drifting through birth and death for hundreds of thousands of kalpas, they fail to see a Buddha and undergo manifold sufferings. To rescue such as these, the Buddha has appeared in the world;
the Tathāgata protects all the worlds, manifesting himself before the presence of every sentient being.
It quiets the suffering of wandering on the perilous path;
This Dharma gate, King of Sound, enters [the world] for those whose evil karma is a heavy obstruction.
The Buddha reveals the wondrous principle to bring about understanding, Like a bright lamp illuminating the world; This Dharma is a majestic weapon that enables clear vision.
In oceans of past eons, the Buddha cultivated all practices, And because he praised all Buddhas of the ten directions, He possesses lofty and far-reaching great renown.
This King of Wisdom has realized that wisdom Is like space, without limit; The Dharma-body is vast, expansive, and inconceivable.
Therefore, he manifests throughout the ten directions; with flaming eyes, he is able to observe all realms of existence.
He proclaims wondrous sounds, preaching the Dharma to benefit all sentient beings;
wherever his voice reaches, all suffering is extinguished. Entering this skillful means is the Vajra Eye.
The Tathāgata is able to expound in a single phrase all meanings that are profound and vast;
such teachings and principles pervade the world, realized by the King of Valiant Wisdom.
For all sentient beings dwelling on deviant paths, the Buddha reveals the inconceivable True Path.
Universally causing the world to become vessels of the Dharma, this valiant one who conquers armies is able to awaken to and understand all meritorious deeds existing in the world;
all of these arise from the light of the Buddha’s radiance.
The ocean of the Buddha’s wisdom is difficult to fathom; such is the liberation of abundant wealth.
Recalling incalculable eons in the past, the Buddha cultivated the ten powers therein, enabling all powers to reach full perfection; this is what King Uccadhvaja understands.
Furthermore, the Mahoraga King Suprajña, through all skillful means of supernatural power, enables sentient beings...
The mahoraga king Accumulated Merit attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to eliminate afflictions and obtain refreshing joy.

The mahoraga king Victorious Wisdom Adorned Topknot attained the liberation door of universally causing all sentient beings with wholesome or unwholesome thoughts and perceptions to enter the pure Dharma.
The mahoraga king Subhāṣitanetra attained the liberation door of the mark of equality in the sovereign power of merit that thoroughly penetrates all non-attachment.
The mahoraga king Pradīpadhvaja attained the liberation door of revealing the path to all sentient beings so that they may leave behind darkness and fear. The mahoraga king Jyotiruttamadhvaja...
The mahoraga king Lion’s Chest attained the liberation door of generating joy by realizing all the virtues of the Buddhas.
The mahoraga king Array of Exquisite Ornaments attained the liberation door of acting as a protector and refuge for all sentient beings through the power of his valor.
The mahoraga king Sound of Wondrous Adornments attained the liberation door of causing boundless joy to arise in all sentient beings according to their recollections.
The Mahoraga King Delightful Liberation attained the liberation door of reaching the perfection of immovability regarding all objects of perception.
The Mahoraga King Lovely Light attained the liberation door of revealing the path of equality to all sentient beings who are unequal. At that time, the virtuous...
The Mahoraga King Prajñātejaprabha, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power,
surveyed the entire assembly of mahoragas and spoke in verse:
"Behold the Tathāgata’s nature, pure and stainless, Universally manifesting majestic light to benefit all beings."
He reveals the path of ambrosia to bring about coolness, so that all sufferings may forever cease and there is no further dependence.

For all sentient beings dwelling in the ocean of existence, who are themselves entangled and shrouded by various evil karmas and delusions, he reveals the dharma of tranquility for their practice; Vimalaghoṣa is able to understand this well.
The Buddha’s wisdom is peerless and inconceivable; Knowing the minds of sentient beings, there is nothing he does not exhaustively perceive.
For their sake, he proclaims the pure Dharma; Thus, one with a crown-like hair-knot can awaken to this:
Innumerable Buddhas appear in the world, Universally acting as fields of merit for all sentient beings.
The ocean of merit is vast and deep, difficult to fathom; The Great King Wondrous Eye can see it all.
He perceives the sorrow, fear, and suffering of all sentient beings;
The Buddha appears everywhere before them to provide protection, Pervading the entire dharma-realm and empty space without exception— This is the sphere of activity of Lamp Banner.
The various merits within a single pore of the Buddha— The entire world together cannot fathom them;
Boundless and inexhaustible, like empty space.
Thus beholding the Tathāgata, the Great Radiant Banner, Who penetrates all dharmas and clearly illuminates their true nature.
Like Mount Sumeru, it is unshakable; Entering this Dharma-gate, the Lion-Chested Buddha, In vast kalpas of the past, gathered an ocean of joy, Deep and inexhaustible;
therefore, all who see it rejoice. This is the entry of Dharmavyūhaghoṣa.
Fully realizing that the dharma-realm is formless, The ocean of pāramitās is completely perfected;
With great light universally saving all sentient beings, Mountains Chest can understand these skillful means.
Behold the Tathāgata’s power of mastery: He manifests his descent throughout the ten directions without partiality.
All sentient beings are universally illuminated and awakened; this wondrous radiance is able to enter [them] skillfully.
Furthermore, the Kinnara King Radiance of Good Wisdom attained the liberation door of "Universal Production of All Joyful Deeds.
The Kinnara King Wondrous Flower Banner attained the [liberation door] that "is able to produce supreme Dharma-joy and cause all to receive it."
The Kinnara King Peaceful and Blissful Liberation attained the liberation door of the vast and pure treasury of faith and understanding that fulfills all merits through various adornments.

The Kinnara King Pleasing Roar attained the liberation door of constantly producing all pleasing sounds that cause those who hear them to be free from sorrow and fear. The Kinnara King Radiance of Jewel Trees...
King Nara attained the liberation door of establishing all sentient beings in great compassion so that they may awaken to their objects of focus.
King Universal Delight in Seeing attained the liberation door of manifesting all exquisite forms of the body.
King Supreme Light Adornment attained the liberation door of knowing from what all supreme adornments arise as their fruit.
The Kinnara King Subtle Flower Banner attained the liberation door of skillfully observing the retributions born of all worldly karma.
The Kinnara King Power to Shake the Earth attained the liberation door of constantly initiating all activities that benefit sentient beings.
The Kinnara King Fierce Lord attained [the liberation door] of skillfully knowing all kinnaras...
The liberation door of Nara’s skillful mastery of the mind.
At that time, the Kinnara King Sunlight of Good Wisdom, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of Kinnaras and spoke in verse:
All the peaceful and blissful things that exist in the world arise entirely from seeing the Buddha;
The Teacher benefits all sentient beings, universally acting as a place of refuge and protection;
He gives birth to all manner of goodness and joy, so that the world may obtain them exhaustlessly.
It causes those who behold it not to do so in vain; This is what the Flower Banner has realized:
The ocean of the Buddha’s merits is inexhaustible, And its limits cannot be found even when sought.
Its radiance shines universally throughout the ten directions; This is the liberation of King Adornment.
The Tathāgata’s great voice constantly flows forth, Revealing the true Dharma that brings freedom from sorrow;
All sentient beings who hear it are filled with joy. This lion’s roar can be believed and accepted;
I observe that the Tathāgata’s sovereign power Arises entirely from what was practiced in the past.
With great compassion, he saves all beings and causes them to be pure;
this king of jewel trees can penetrate the realization that a Tathāgata is difficult to see or hear. Sentient beings encounter him only once in hundreds of millions of eons;
as a field of adornment for beings, he is fully perfected—this is what King Sudarśana beholds.
Behold the Great Wisdom of the Tathāgata, which universally accords with the desires of the hearts of all sentient beings;
there is no path of omniscience that it does not proclaim.
This most supreme adornment can comprehend the vast and inconceivable ocean of karma, from which arise the suffering and happiness of all living beings.
All these can be revealed; this King of Flower Banners understands them.
The supernatural powers of the Buddhas proceed without interruption, Constantly shaking the great earth throughout the ten directions, Yet no sentient beings are able to know them;
This one of vast power perceives them clearly at all times.
Abiding within the assembly, he manifests supernormal powers, emitting great radiance to awaken beings and reveal the realm of all Tathāgatas;
this Lord of Fierce Power is able to observe all.
Furthermore, the Great Swift-Force Garuḍa King has attained an unattached and unobstructed eye, universally observing the assembly.
The Garuḍa King Birth-Realm Liberation Gate attained the liberation gate of universally abiding in the dharma-realm to teach and transform sentient beings.
The Garuḍa King Pure and Swift attained the liberation gate of the power of diligence that universally accomplishes the pāramitās.
The Garuḍa King Adorned with Non-Retrogressive Mind attained [the liberation gate of] valor.
The Garuḍa King Power-Entry into the Tathāgata’s Sphere attained the liberation door of entering the ocean-like wisdom of the Buddha’s vast conduct.

The Garuḍa King Firm Dharma Pure Light attained the liberation door of accomplishing the wisdom that distinguishes the infinite varieties of sentient beings. The Garuḍa King Exquisite Ornamented Crown Tuft...
The Garuḍa King Universal Swift Manifestation attained the liberation door of accomplishing indestructible power of equanimity.
The Garuḍa King Universal Ocean Contemplation attained the liberation door of manifesting forms while knowing the bodies of all sentient beings. The Garuḍa King Dragon-Sound Great Eye-Essence...
They attain the liberation door of the wisdom that universally enters into the knowledge of the deaths and births of all sentient beings.
At that time, the Great Kāla-vega-gati Garuḍa King, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of Garuḍas and spoke these verses:
The Buddha-eye is vast and boundless, universally beholding all lands throughout the ten directions;
the sentient beings therein are immeasurable, yet he manifests great spiritual powers to subdue them all.
The Buddha’s power of spiritual penetration is unimpeded, sitting pervasively beneath the Bodhi trees throughout the ten directions.
The manifestation of Dharma is like clouds that completely fill [the sky]; Baoji (Ratnaśikhin) hears this and his mind does not resist.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated all practices, Universally purifying the vast pāramitās, Making offerings to all Tathāgatas;
This King of Swift Speed possesses deep faith and understanding.
Within each and every pore of the Tathāgata, In a single thought-moment, infinite practices are universally manifested.
Such inconceivable realms of the Buddha— The adornments of non-retrogression are all clearly beheld.
The Buddha’s conduct is vast and inconceivable; No sentient beings are able to fathom it.
The Teacher’s ocean of merit and wisdom, the sphere of activity of this King of Upholding,
the Tathāgata’s immeasurable light of wisdom, which can extinguish the net of delusion and confusion of sentient beings and protects all the worlds—
this is that which is upheld and proclaimed by Dṛḍhadharma.
The city of Dharma is vast and inexhaustible; its gates are manifold and beyond measure.
The Tathāgata, appearing in the world, has widely opened and proclaimed it.
This wondrous Crown-Hair (Uṣṇīṣa) can clearly enter into the single Dharma-body of all Buddhas—true suchness, equal and without discrimination.
By this power, the Buddha always dwells in peace; The King of Universal Swift Manifestation expounds this fully.
In all former existences, the Buddha gathered in sentient beings; He universally radiates light throughout the world, Using various skillful means to demonstrate subduing.
This supreme Dharma-gate was realized by Ocean of Contemplation.
The Buddha observes that all lands abide entirely within the ocean of karma;
he rains down the rain of Dharma therein—such is the liberation of Dragon Sound.
Furthermore, the Asura King Rāhu attained the liberation door of manifesting as the sovereign lord of the great assembly.
The Asura King Mahāmati attained the liberation door of manifesting immeasurable kalpas.
The Asura King Skillful Illusion attained the liberation door of extinguishing the suffering of all sentient beings and making them pure.
The Asura King Great Retinue attained the liberation door of adorning oneself by practicing all ascetic austerities. The Asura King Bali...
The Asura King attained the liberation door of shaking the boundless realms of the ten directions.
The Asura King Universal Radiance attained the liberation door of establishing all sentient beings through various skillful means.
The Asura King Firm Conduct Sublime Adornment attained the liberation door of universally gathering indestructible roots of goodness to purify all defiled attachments.
The asura king Vast Cause Wisdom attained the liberation door of being a master free from doubt through the power of great compassion.
The asura king Manifesting Supreme Virtue attained the liberation door of causing all to see the Buddha, serving and making offerings to him, and cultivating all roots of goodness.
The asura king Fine Sound attained the liberation door of universally entering all realms of existence with resolute and impartial conduct.
The Gate of Liberation. At that time, Rāhu, the Asura King, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of asuras and spoke in verse:
Among all the vast assemblies throughout the ten directions, the Buddha is the most preeminent;
his radiance shines everywhere, equal to space, appearing universally before all sentient beings.
Within a single kṣaṇa, he clearly manifests all the buddha-fields of hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas.
Radiating light to transform sentient beings, there is nowhere it does not reach; Thus Vimala deeply praises and rejoices in the Tathāgata’s realm, which is without equal.
Through various Dharma gates, he constantly benefits sentient beings, causing all suffering to be extinguished; The King of Śambara is able to see this.
Having practiced asceticism for immeasurable eons to benefit sentient beings and purify the world,
the Sage’s wisdom has thus been fully perfected. This King of Great Retinues beholds the Buddha’s unimpeded and peerless great supernormal powers,
which cause all lands throughout the ten directions to tremble universally.
He causes no fear or terror among sentient beings; with great power, he clearly understands this.

When a Buddha appears in the world to save sentient beings, he reveals the path of omniscience in its entirety, causing all to abandon suffering and attain peace and happiness. This meaning has been extensively expounded by Samantaprabha.
The ocean of all merits existing in the world—through the power of the Buddha, these can be universally purified.
The Buddha is able to reveal the place of liberation; through firm practice and adornment, one enters this gate.
The great compassionate body of the Buddha is peerless; moving everywhere without obstruction, it allows all to see.
Just as reflections appear in the world, through wisdom you can proclaim these rare and peerless great supernormal powers;
manifesting bodies everywhere to fill the Dharma-realm,
each sitting beneath a Bodhi tree— you who possess this supreme virtue can explain this meaning.
The Tathāgata practiced throughout the three periods of time; there is no cycle of rebirth in any realm through which he has not passed.
He has liberated sentient beings from suffering without exception—this is what King Wondrous Sound extols.
Furthermore, the Palace-Master Goddess of Day manifests the liberation door of universally entering all worlds. She then... [proceeded to] arouse... [her resolve].
The day-dwelling spirit Utpanna-jñāna-gandha-prabhā attained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings to benefit them, causing them to rejoice and be satisfied.
