The day-dwelling spirit Priya-vyūha-rati attained the liberation door of being able to emit the light of infinite, delightful Dharma.
The day-dwelling spirit Puṣpa-gandha-suvimala-prabhā attained the liberation door of awakening infinite sentient beings.

The night goddess Pure Faith and Resolve attained the liberation door of the liberation of the mind. The day goddess Universal Gathering of Sublime Medicines attained the liberation door of the power of universally gathered and adorned universal radiance.
The day goddess Joyful Action and Delightful Eyes attained the liberation door of universally awakening all sentient beings in suffering and joy, causing them all to attain the bliss of the Dharma.
The day goddess Contemplating Directions and Universally Manifesting attained...

The gate of liberation of the differentiated bodies throughout the ten directions of the Dharma-realm; the gate of liberation of the Day-Ruling Spirit Sovereign of Great Compassion’s Power, who rescues and protects all sentient beings and brings them peace and happiness;
the gate of liberation of the Day-Ruling Spirit Sovereign of the Radiance of Roots of Goodness, who attains the power of merit that universally generates joy and contentment;
and the Day-Ruling Spirit Sovereign of Exquisite Flower Garlands, who attains renown whose fame is heard everywhere.
The liberation door of all sentient beings who see [this] obtaining benefit.
At that time, the Palace-Master Day-God, manifesting by the Buddha’s awesome power, surveyed the entire host of Palace-Master Day-Gods and spoke these verses:
The Buddha’s wisdom is like space, without end; its radiance shines throughout the ten directions, fully knowing the mental activities of all sentient beings.
There is nothing in all worlds that he does not enter and know;
he understands the inclinations of the hearts of all beings and, as is appropriate, preaches for them the ocean of various dharmas.
The meanings of phrases are vast and each is distinct; the deity Prajñāvatī can perceive them all.
The Buddha emits light that illuminates the world; seeing and hearing this, one rejoices without fail.
He reveals the profound, vast, and quiescent state; through this joy, the mind is adorned and awakened to understanding.
The Buddha rains down the Dharma rain in boundless measure, Causing all who see it to experience great joy;
From this, the most supreme roots of goodness are born.
Through the power of awakening that enters such wondrous light realized by the mind, That which was cultivated throughout vast eons becomes entirely pure.
Thus, all these are for the sake of gathering in sentient beings; this is what the goddess Subhavyūha understands.
Through various skillful means, she transforms the multitudes of living beings;
whether they see her or hear her, they all receive benefit, causing them all to leap with great joy. Thus does the goddess Divyalocanā behold.
The One Possessing the Ten Powers manifests throughout the world; throughout the ten directions and the entire dharma-realm, there is nothing left out.
His essential nature is neither non-existent nor existent; this is the entryway of the deity Fangshen.
Amidst the perilous and difficult conditions of the cycle of birth and death, the Tathāgata, out of compassion, appears in the world.
Causing all suffering to be entirely extinguished—this gate of liberation abides by the power of compassion for sentient beings submerged in darkness throughout the eternal night.
The Buddha preaches the Dharma for them, greatly illuminating them so that all may attain happiness and eliminate their manifold sufferings. The deity Mahāśubhaprabha enters this gate.
The Tathāgata’s measure of merit is equal to space, From which all the merits of the world arise;
Whatever he does never goes to waste— Thus is attained the liberation "Flower-Garland.
Next, the night goddess Samantaśrīviśuddhaprabhā attained the liberation "Great Courageous Vigor," which is the joy of tranquil meditative concentration.
The Night Goddess Joyful-Eye-Contemplating-the-Lord-of-the-World attained the liberation door of the marks of vast, pure, and delightful merit.
The Night Goddess Protecting the Vital Essence of the World attained the liberation door of universally manifesting in the world to discipline sentient beings.
The Night Goddess Sound of the Ocean of Tranquility attained the liberation door of accumulating a vast mind of joy. Universally...
The Night Goddess Manifesting Auspiciousness attained the liberation door of profound, sovereign, and pleasing speech.
The Night Goddess Universally Producing Tree Blossoms attained the liberation door of the treasury of vast joy fulfilled by light.
The Night Goddess Impartially Protecting and Nurturing attained the liberation door of awakening sentient beings and causing their roots of goodness to mature. [The Night Goddess] Playful...
The Night Goddess Sukhāvatī attained the liberation door of infinite compassion for the protection of sentient beings.
The Night Goddess Sarvendriyasatatasamtuṣṭā attained the liberation door of the great compassion that universally manifests adornments.
The Night Goddess Śubhadarśanā attained the liberation door of universally causing all sentient beings to have their desires fulfilled. At that time, Samantaguṇaviśuddha...
The Night-Spirit Prabhāvatī, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of night-spirits and spoke these verses:
“You should behold the conduct of the Buddha— Vast, tranquil, and possessing the nature of space.
He has completely purified the boundless ocean of desires; Stainless, majestic, and illuminating the ten directions.”
All the worlds delight in seeing him; Only once in an ocean of immeasurable eons is he encountered.

His great compassion regards all beings without exception; This gate of liberation is beheld by Avalokiteśvara, The Guide who protects all the worlds, So that all sentient beings see him standing before them.
Able to purify all realms of existence, Thus the World-Protector observes the Buddha’s past cultivation of the ocean of joy— Vast, boundless, and unfathomable;
therefore, all who see it are filled with delight. This is what Śāntasvara has realized.

The realm of the Tathāgata is immeasurable; though quiescent, he can manifest throughout the ten directions, universally causing the minds of all beings to be pure. Hearing this, the Night Goddess Śrī rejoiced:
"Among beings who lack merit, the Buddha possesses the majestic splendor of great merit and adornment."
He reveals to them the dharma of detachment, tranquility, and extinction; The Spirit Universal Flower-Producer awakens to this path.

Manifesting great supernormal powers throughout the ten directions, He tames all sentient beings and causes them all to see his various forms and appearances; This is what the Spirit Guardian and Nurturer contemplates.

In every thought-moment of the past, the Tathāgata has completely purified the ocean of skillful means, compassion, and mercy, protecting and rescuing the world without exception. This is the liberation of the deity Puṇyasukha:
he constantly dispels the delusion, confusion, and turbidity of sentient beings; his mind is firm and poisonous, most truly fearsome.
The Tathāgata appears out of compassion; this deity Destroyer of Enmity can awaken to joy.
Because the Buddha cultivated practices for the sake of sentient beings in the past, he fulfilled all their wishes and desires;
thus he was endowed with the marks of merit and virtue—this is the sphere of entry for the deity Manifesting Blessings.
Furthermore, the directional spirit Ubhayavyāpīśvara attained the liberation door of the power of universal protection;
the directional spirit Samantaprabhāsa attained the liberation door of the supernatural activity of accomplishing the transformation of all sentient beings;
and the directional spirit Prabhācāra-vyūha attained the liberation door of the great light that shatters all dark obstructions and gives rise to joy and bliss.
The Guardian Spirit of the Direction of Unobstructed Universal Travel attained the liberation door of "Manifesting Everywhere Without Vain Effort.
The Guardian Spirit of the Direction of Permanently Severing Delusion attained the liberation door of "Manifesting Names Equal in Number to All Sentient Beings to Generate Merit.
The Guardian Spirit of the Direction of Roaming Throughout the Pure Void attained the liberation door of "Constantly Emitting Sublime Sounds so that All Listeners..."
The goddess of the quarter named Joyful Liberation attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to rejoice by raining down universally like a dragon.
The goddess of the quarter named Unconfused Topknot-Eye attained the liberation door of the sovereign power to manifest the non-differentiation of the karma of all sentient beings.
The goddess of the quarter named Universal Observer of the World attained the observation of one... [liberation door].

The liberation door of various karmic liberations among all realms of rebirth; the liberation door of the Sovereign Deity of the Directions who, having traveled everywhere, attains the ultimate fulfillment of his tasks and gives rise to joy in all sentient beings.

At that time, the Sovereign Deity of the Directions who dwells everywhere, receiving the Buddha’s majestic power, surveyed the entire assembly of Sovereign Deities of the Directions and spoke these verses:
The Tathāgata, sovereign over the world, teaches and transforms all living beings;
He universally reveals the Dharma gates so that they may awaken and enter them, Causing them all to attain supreme wisdom,
with immeasurable supernatural powers equal to those of all beings, Manifesting various forms according to their inclinations.
All who see him are blessed with liberation from suffering; this is the power of the liberation of the deity Prabhāsa.
For the ocean of sentient beings obscured by darkness, the Buddha manifests the great radiance of the Dharma-torch;
its light shines everywhere so that there is nowhere it does not reach—this is the liberation adorned by such conduct.

Possessing all the various sounds of the world, he universally turns the wheel of Dharma such that there is nothing those sentient beings who listen do not understand, and their afflictions are extinguished; this is what the deity Vyāpini has realized:
all the names existing in every world arise as being equal to the name of the Buddha.
Causing all sentient beings to leave behind delusion and confusion—this is the sphere of activity of the One Who Severs Delusion.

If there are sentient beings who come before the Buddha and hear the Tathāgata’s exquisite voice, there are none whose hearts do not give rise to great joy; they roam throughout space and awaken to this Dharma.

In each and every instant, the Buddha universally rains down the boundless rain of the Great Dharma, causing the afflictions of all sentient beings to be extinguished; this is what the deity Meghadhvaja understands.
Regarding the ocean of all karmas in all worlds, the Buddha reveals them all equally and without distinction.
Universally causing all sentient beings to eliminate karma and delusion—this is what the deity Keśinī fully understands.
The ground of omniscience is without limit; the Tathāgata perceives and clearly comprehends the various minds of all sentient beings. This vast gateway is observed by Avalokiteśvara.
The Buddha, having cultivated all practices in the past, has fully perfected the immeasurable perfections;
with great compassion and pity, he benefits all sentient beings—this is the liberation of the Spirit of Universal Roaming.
Furthermore, the Lord of the Space-Spirits, Pure Light Shining Everywhere, has attained the understanding that universally knows the minds of all sentient beings in every realm of existence.
The goddess of space named Liberation of Universal Deliverance attained the liberation door of universally entering the dharma-realm.
The goddess of space named Producing Auspicious Winds attained the liberation door of penetrating the bodily forms of boundless realms.

The goddess of space named Abiding Securely Free from Obstructions attained the liberation door of being able to eliminate the obstacles of karma and delusion for all sentient beings. The goddess of space named Vast Steps and Wondrous Topknot...
The space-ruling spirit Lord of Universal Observation attained the liberation door of contemplating the vast ocean of conduct.
The space-ruling spirit Unobstructed Radiance attained the liberation door of the light of great compassion universally rescuing all sentient beings from calamities and distress.
The space-ruling spirit Unobstructed Supreme Power attained the liberation door of universally entering the power of merit that is entirely without attachment.
The space-ruling spirit Vimalaprabhā attained the liberation door of enabling the minds of all sentient beings to be free from all hindrances and become pure.
The space-ruling spirit Gambhīrasvarā attained the liberation door of the light of wisdom that universally perceives the ten directions.
The space-ruling spirit Prabhāvyāpinī attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the world without moving from her original place.
[The] Gate. At that time, the Space-Ruling Spirit named Pure Light Shining Everywhere, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of space-ruling spirits and spoke these verses:
The Tathāgata’s vast eyes are as pure as space; He perceives all sentient beings everywhere with complete clarity.
The great radiance of the Buddha’s body Shines throughout the ten directions, appearing before all.
Universally traveling to observe this path, The Buddha’s body is like space.
Unborn and without anything to be grasped, Without attainment and without intrinsic nature— The Tathāgata seen by the Auspicious Wind Extensively taught all the noble paths over immeasurable eons.
Universal Extinction of Sentient Beings’ Obscurations and Perfect Radiance realized this gateway; I contemplate the Buddha’s past Accumulation of bodhisattva practices.
All act for the peace of the world; The One with the Wondrous Topknot practices this Dharma.
All realms of sentient beings wander in the ocean of birth and death; The Buddha emits light that extinguishes suffering.
The Unobstructed Divine One can see the treasury of pure merit; He is able to serve as a field of blessings for the world, Awakening others through wisdom accordingly.
The God of Power realized here that sentient beings are shrouded by delusion and wander through perilous paths;
the Buddha then radiated forth brilliant light. The God Free from Defilement was able to witness this:
wisdom is boundless, manifesting all lands as its radiance illuminates the world; through this wondrous sound, he beheld the Buddha.
The Buddha, for the sake of delivering sentient beings, cultivates practice throughout the ten directions; with such a mind of great vows, he manifests universally and is able to observe all.
Furthermore, the Wind Spirit named Sovereign of Unobstructed Radiance has attained universal entry into the Buddha-dharma and the understanding of all worlds.
The wind spirit named Door of Liberation manifests everywhere; he attained the liberation door of the vast and universal offering to the Buddhas appearing in immeasurable lands.
The wind spirit named Cloud Banner Whirlwind attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the illnesses of all sentient beings with fragrant winds.
The wind spirit named Pure Light Adornment attained the [liberation door] of universally generating all sentient beings...
The wind spirit Root of Virtue Crushing the Mountain of Heavy Obstacles attained the liberation door of destroying heavy obstructions.

The wind spirit Power Able to Exhaust the Lord of Waters attained the liberation door of being able to shatter the infinite hosts of evil Māras. The wind spirit Great Sound Roaring Everywhere attained the liberation door of forever extinguishing the fears of all sentient beings.
The wind spirit Topknot Hanging from Tree Tips attained the liberation door of entering into all dharmas.
The wind spirit presiding over the ocean of eloquence regarding the true nature attained the liberation door of the treasury of skillful means for taming all sentient beings.
The wind spirit presiding over various palaces attained the liberation door of entering the gate of tranquil meditative concentration to extinguish the darkness of extreme ignorance.
The wind spirit presiding over the universal illumination of great light attained... [according to context]... following... [the remainder of the sentence].
The liberation door of the unimpeded power of acting in accordance with the conduct of all sentient beings.
At that time, the wind-spirit Sovereign of Unimpeded Radiance, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of wind-spirits and spoke in verse:
The Dharma of all Buddhas is profoundly deep; Through unimpeded skillful means, they are able to enter everywhere.
They constantly appear throughout all worlds, Without marks, without form, and without shadow.
Observe how the Tathāgata in the past Made offerings to boundless Buddhas in a single thought-moment.
Such courageous conduct for enlightenment— this, the spirit Samantāloka can fully comprehend.
The inconceivable ways in which the Tathāgata, the Savior of the World, employs skillful means so that none go in vain,
causing all sentient beings to be free from every suffering— this is the liberation of the spirit Meghadhvaja.
Sentient beings lacking merit undergo manifold sufferings, Constantly deluded and obscured by heavy veils and dense barriers;
May all be brought to liberation—this is what the deity Pure Light understands.
The vast and great supernormal powers of the Tathāgata Completely annihilate all hosts of māras.
All skillful means for subduing [beings], The courageous power and majesty that can discern— The Buddha emits wondrous sounds from every pore;
Those sounds pervade the entire world, Causing all suffering and fear to be stilled. This is what the deity Samantaghoṣa understands.
Throughout oceans of all lands, for inconceivable eons, the Buddha constantly expounds this wondrous eloquence of the Tathāgata-ground;
the deity Crest-Topknot is able to understand and realize it.
Regarding all doors of skillful means, the Buddha’s wisdom enters them all without any obstruction.
The realm is boundless and without equal; this is the liberation of the Spirit of Universal Practice.

The realm of the Tathāgata is without limit; through skillful means everywhere, he causes all to see him, yet his body is tranquil and free from all marks—this is the liberation door of the Spirit of Various Palaces.
"The Tathāgata cultivated all practices throughout oceans of kalpas, and all his powers were brought to full perfection;
he is able to accord with worldly dharmas to respond to sentient beings—this is what the spirit Universal Illumination has seen.
Next, from the Gandharva King Self-Holding Country up to the Wind Spirit Unobstructed Radiance Lord:
Essential Outline of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra of the Buddha, Volumes Three and Four.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda, a Śramaṇa from the Kingdom of Khotan.
Commentary on the Meaning by the Śramaṇa Chengguan of Qingliangshan Dàhuá yán Sī;
Extracted by the Śramaṇa Hanshan Deqing of Fáyún Sī on Kuāngshān.
Chapter One: The Array of the Sublime Adornments of Worldly Rulers, Part Four.
Furthermore, the Fire God Universal Radiance Flame-Treasury attained the liberation door of completely eliminating all darkness in the world.
The Fire God Universal Gathering Light Banner attained the liberation door of being able to pacify the suffering of the drifting heat-afflictions of the delusions of all sentient beings.
The Fire God Great Light Pervasive Illumination attained the treasury of immovable power of merit and great compassion.
The Fire God Sovereign of the Palace of Myriad Wonders attained the liberation door of manifesting the boundless power of the Tathāgata’s spiritual transformations.
The Fire God Sovereign of Exhaustless Radiant Topknot attained the liberation door of illuminating the boundless realm of empty space with light.
The Fire God Sovereign of Eyes of Various Flames attained the tranquil light adorned by various merits.

The liberation door of the Fire God Sovereign of the Palace Halls of the Ten Directions, who has attained the liberation door of being able to extinguish the blazing sufferings of all realms of existence in the world;
the Fire God Sovereign of Majestic Light and Mastery, who has attained the liberation door of freely awakening all worlds;
and the Fire God Sovereign Who Illuminates the Ten Directions, who has attained the permanent destruction of all... [sufferings].
The Fire-Ruling Spirit Gate of Sound and Lightning attains the liberation door of the great thunderous roar that accomplishes all powers of aspiration.
At that time, the Fire-Ruling Spirit Treasury of Universal Radiant Flames, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed the entire assembly of fire-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
Behold the power of the Tathāgata’s diligence, vast and inconceivable across billions of eons;
for the sake of benefiting sentient beings, he appears in the world and causes all darkness and obstructions to be extinguished.
Sentient beings give rise to various views through ignorance, and their afflictions flow like rivers and blaze like fire.
The Guide’s skillful means completely eliminate [all obscurations]; The Universal Radiance Banner attained awakening here.
His merit is like space, without end; One cannot find its limit even by seeking it.
This Buddha’s great compassion is effortless; Its light shines forth, and upon awakening and entering, the mind gives rise to joy.
I observe the conduct of the Tathāgata, Which spans an ocean of kalpas without limit;
Thus he manifests powers of supernatural transformation, Comprehended by the spirits of the wondrous palaces.
Cultivated and perfected over inconceivable billions of kalpas, One cannot know its boundaries even by seeking them.
Expounding the true reality of phenomena to bring joy—this is what the deity Infinite Light perceives.
All the vast assemblies throughout the ten directions gaze up at the Buddha;
his tranquil radiance illuminates the world—this is what the deity Subtle Flame can comprehend.
The Muni appears in all worlds, seated within every palace, raining down the boundless and vast Dharma everywhere. This is the realm of the deities of the ten directions;
the wisdom of the Buddhas is most profound, manifesting in the world with mastery over all phenomena.
He is able to fully elucidate the true principle; Through his majestic radiance, those who realize this rejoice with glad hearts.
All views are shrouded by the darkness of ignorance; Sentient beings, deluded, constantly wander in saṃsāra.
The Buddha opens and reveals the wondrous gateway of the Dharma; His light shines upon all quarters, enabling gods and humans to awaken and enter.
The gates of aspiration are vast and inconceivable; having purified the powers of diligence through cultivation, they manifest exactly as in former vows.
This is what the spirit Vajrasvara understands.
Furthermore, the water spirit Samantameghaketu-pramukha attains the compassionate liberation that brings equal benefit to all sentient beings.
The water spirit Ocean Tide Cloud Sound attained the liberation door of the adornment of boundless dharmas.
The water spirit Wondrous Color Wheel Topknot attained the liberation door of universally gathering those to be transformed through skillful means of observation.
The water spirit Skillful Whirlpool attained the liberation door of universally expounding the profound realms of all Buddhas. The water spirit Stainless Fragrance Accumulation...
The water-ruling spirit Universal Manifestation of Pure Great Radiance attained the liberation door of the pure great radiance that appears everywhere.
The water-ruling spirit Light-Sound of the Bridge of Merit attained the liberation door of the signless and natureless pure dharma-realm.

The water-ruling spirit Sovereign Contentment attained the liberation door of the inexhaustible ocean of great compassion. The water-ruling spirit Pure Joy of Excellent Sound attained [the liberation door] regarding the bodhisattva...
Within the assembly at the site of enlightenment, they attained the liberation door of the Great Treasury of Joy.
The Water Spirit Sovereign of Universally Manifesting Majestic Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting through the power of unimpeded and vast merit.

The Water Spirit Sovereign of Roaring Sounds Pervading the Ocean attained the liberation door of observing all sentient beings and initiating skillful means for their subduing that are as vast as space.

[The Chapter on] the Gate. At that time, the water-governing spirit named Cloud Banner of Universal Arising, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of water-governing spirits and spoke in verse:
Pure gates of compassion, as numerous as the atoms of a world-system, together produce a single sublime mark of the Tathāgata;
it is not otherwise for each and every mark, and thus those who behold them never tire of doing so.
When the World-Honored One practiced his path in the past, he went everywhere to the abodes of all Tathāgatas.
He cultivates various purifications without weariness; through such skillful means, his voice like a cloud enters the Buddhas throughout all ten directions.
He remains tranquil and unmoving, without coming or going, yet he causes all sentient beings to behold him through his manifestations. This is what the Crest-Wheel knows.
The realm of the Tathāgata is boundless; all sentient beings cannot comprehend it.
With wondrous sounds he proclaims it throughout the ten directions; this is the sphere of activity of the deity Sunetra.
The radiance of the World-Honored One is inexhaustible, pervading the inconceivable Dharma-realm.
He preaches the Dharma to teach and transform sentient beings; this is what the spirit Pure Fragrance perceives.
The Tathāgata is pure and equal to space, signless and formless, pervading the ten directions, yet causing all in the assembly to see him without exception;
this is what the spirit Merit Light observes well.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the gate of great compassion; His mind was vast and pervasive, equal to all sentient beings.

Therefore, he appears in the world like a cloud; Through this gate of liberation, he fully knows and understands all lands throughout the ten directions, And beholds the Tathāgata seated upon his throne in each.
Clearly and brilliantly awakened to great Bodhi; such is the entry into the Joyful Sound.
The Tathāgata’s conduct is unimpeded; he travels everywhere to all lands in the ten directions, manifesting great supernormal powers in each place.
Having universally manifested his majestic radiance, he has attained awakening.
Cultivating boundless practices of skillful means, they fill the entire realm of sentient beings;
their wondrous applications of supernormal powers never cease for a moment, and they are able to enter this roar that pervades the ocean.
Furthermore, the Ocean-Ruling Spirit named Jewel-Light-Producer attains the merit of bestowing with an impartial mind upon all sentient beings.
The ocean-dwelling deity Adorned with All Jewels attained the liberation door of adorning the body with all manner of jewels.
The ocean-dwelling deity Sovereign of the Indestructible Vajra Banner attained the liberation door of skillfully employing expedient means to protect the roots of goodness of all sentient beings.

The ocean-dwelling deity Unmixed by Dust and Defilement attained the liberation door of being able to exhaust the ocean of afflictions of all sentient beings. The ocean-dwelling deity Constantly Abiding in the Waves...
The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of All Beings Causing Them to Leave Evil Realms Attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to leave evil realms and attain deliverance.
The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of Auspicious Jewel Moon Attained the liberation door of universally extinguishing the great darkness of ignorance.

The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of Wondrous Flower Dragon Topknot Attained the liberation door of extinguishing the suffering of all realms of existence and bestowing peace and happiness. The ocean-dwelling spirit Sovereign of Universal Sustaining Light and Flavor Attained the purification of all...
The ocean-dwelling spirit Lord of the Flower-Radiance of Jewel Flames attained the liberation door of generating the bodhicitta of all jewel-seed natures.
The ocean-dwelling spirit Lord of the Diamond Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of the ocean of merit of the immovable mind.
The ocean-dwelling spirit Lord of Ocean Tides and Thunderous Sound attained the liberation door of universally entering the dharma-realm.
Regarding the gates of samādhi and the gates of liberation, at that time the ocean-ruling spirit named Jewel-Light-Master, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed all the hosts of ocean-ruling spirits and spoke these verses:
Throughout inconceivable oceans of great kalpas, They make offerings to all Tathāgatas;
Universally bestowing merit upon all living beings, Therefore they are most peerless in their dignified majesty,
Appearing throughout every world, Knowing the faculties and desires of all sentient beings without exception.
Universally proclaiming the great ocean of the Dharma, this is what the steadfast banner has joyfully realized;
The Teacher of all beings in the world, with the great rain from the clouds of Dharma, immeasurable and unfathomable, Extinguishes the endless oceans of suffering;
this is the entrance into which the one free from defilement has entered.
All sentient beings are shrouded by afflictions, Circulating through various realms and undergoing manifold sufferings;
For their sake, he reveals the realm of the Tathāgata— The Spirit of the Universal Water Palace enters this gate.
Throughout an ocean of inconceivable eons, The Buddha has practiced all deeds without end.
Forever severing the net of sentient beings' delusions and confusion, The Jewel Moon is able to clearly enter this;
Seeing that sentient beings are constantly terrified As they wander through the great ocean of birth and death, He reveals to them the unsurpassed path of the Tathāgata;
Thus, Dragon Topknot attained awakening and gave rise to joy.
The realm of all Buddhas is inconceivable; The Dharma-realm and empty space share the same mark of equality.
It can purify the net of sentient beings' ignorance and delusion; One who upholds and savors it can thus proclaim it.
The Buddha-eye is pure and inconceivable, Comprehending and surveying all realms without exception.
Universally showing all sentient beings the various wondrous paths—this is what the mind of Padmaprabha has realized.
The vast and countless armies of Māra are entirely crushed and extinguished in a single kṣaṇa;
his mind is unshakable and difficult to fathom—such is the skillful means of Vajramaunī.
Universally throughout the ten directions they proclaim wondrous sounds; Those sounds pervade the entire dharma-realm without exception.
This is the realm of the Tathāgata’s samādhi, The sphere of activity of the spirit Ocean-Tide Sound.
Furthermore, the River-Spirit Sovereign of Universally Emitting Swift Currents attained the liberation door of "universally raining down boundless Dharma-rain. Universally...
The River Spirit Pure Spring Grotto attained the liberation door of manifesting before all sentient beings to cause them to forever leave affliction behind and achieve deliverance.
The River Spirit Dust-Free Pure Eye attained the liberation door of universally cleansing the dust and grime of all sentient beings' delusions through the skillful means of great compassion.
The River Spirit Universal Roar in the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of constantly producing benefit.
The River Goddess Sovereign of Sentient Beings’ Sounds attained the liberation door of universally rescuing and protecting all beings.
The River Goddess Sovereign of Cool Pure Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting all roots of goodness that bring refreshing coolness.
The River Goddess Sovereign of Universal Joy attained the liberation door of practicing with... [the full text continues].
The river spirit Sovereign of Sufficient Giving attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to forever leave behind stinginess and attachment.
The river spirit Sovereign of Vast Virtuous Victory Banners attained the liberation door of acting as a field of merit that brings joy to all.

The river spirit Sovereign of Light Illuminating All Worlds attained the liberation door of being able to purify those among all sentient beings who are defiled and to bring joy to those whose poison is anger. The ocean...
The River Goddess Virtuous Radiance attained the liberation door of being able to cause all sentient beings to enter the ocean of liberation and constantly experience perfect bliss.
At that time, the River Goddess Sovereign of Universally Emitted Swift Currents, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority,
surveyed the entire assembly of river goddesses and spoke these verses:
In the past, for the sake of sentient beings, the Tathāgata cultivated the boundless practices of the ocean of Dharma;
like a torrential rain that clears the scorching heat, he universally extinguished the fever of the afflictions of sentient beings.
What the Buddha previously found difficult to proclaim throughout immeasurable kalpas, he has now purified in the world with the radiance of his vows.
Those whose faculties are matured are led to awaken to the Way; this is the great compassionate skillful means realized by the spirit Pujaka, which is equal toward all sentient beings.
He manifests before them all to constantly transform and guide them, universally purifying the defilements of their afflictions;
seeing this with pure eyes, I am filled with deep joy.
The Buddha proclaims a wondrous sound that reaches all ears;
Sentient beings cherish it with joyful hearts, Causing them all to wash away immeasurable suffering. This is the liberation of the deity Vyāghrarāja:
In the past, while practicing the bodhisattva path, For the sake of benefiting sentient beings, he did so for immeasurable eons.
Therefore, this radiance pervades the world; The guardian deity, mindful of it, gives rise to joy.
In the past, the Buddha practiced austerities for the sake of sentient beings, Using various skillful means to bring them to maturity.
He universally purifies the ocean of merit and eliminates all suffering; Anavatapta, seeing this, rejoices in his heart.
The gate of giving is vast and inexhaustible, Benefiting all sentient beings without exception;
It enables all who see it to be free from stinginess and attachment— This is what the deity Sampraharṣaṇī has realized.
The Buddha practiced these true expedient means in the past, Thereby accomplishing an ocean of boundless merit.
It causes all who behold it not to fail in joy; this supreme banner-like deity awakens the hearts of beings with delight.
Because it purifies all defilements of sentient beings and gives rise to compassion for all enemies and harm, it attains radiant light that fills the void;
the river deities of the entire world see it and rejoice.
The Buddha is an ocean of merit and a field of blessings; he is able to cause all beings to leave behind all evils and even achieve great Bodhi. This is the liberation of the deity Samudraprabha.
Furthermore, the deity Kṣetrapati-mṛdutarasvarāgrya has attained the ability to provide the flavor of the Dharma to all sentient beings, causing them to achieve it.

Regarding the liberation door of the Buddha’s body: at that time, the field-protecting spirit Flower-Pure-Light attained the liberation door of enabling all sentient beings to experience vast and great joy;
the field-protecting spirit Color-Strength-Vigorous attained the liberation door of purifying all realms through the dharma-door of universal perfection;
and the field-protecting spirit Increasing Vitality attained the vision of the Buddha.
The liberation door of the power of immeasurable great compassion and miraculous transformations;
the liberation door of the Crop-Producing Spirit Mastering the Roots of Birth who universally manifests as the field of merit for Buddhas, causing all sown seeds never to be lost or destroyed;

the liberation door of the Crop-Producing Spirit Wondrously Adorned Circular Topknot who causes the flowers of pure faith to bloom universally among sentient beings; and the liberation door of the Crop-Producing Spirit Moistening Pure Flowers...
The spirit who presides over crops and brings great compassion and mercy to all sentient beings attained the liberation door of causing the ocean of merit and virtue to increase.
The spirit who presides over crops and masters exquisite fragrances attained the liberation door of extensively revealing and teaching all dharmas of practice.

The spirit who presides over crops and is beloved by all who see her attained the power to cause all sentient beings throughout the dharma-realm to abandon indolence, sorrow, affliction, and all other evils.

The liberation door of the purity of liberation; the harvest-lord deity Radiance Free from Defilement attained the liberation door of observing the roots of goodness of all sentient beings and preaching the Dharma according to their needs, causing the assembly to rejoice and be fully satisfied.
At that time, the harvest-lord deity Exquisite Soft Flavor, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire host of harvest-lord deities and spoke in verse:
The Tathāgata’s unsurpassed ocean of merit universally manifests as bright lamps illuminating the world;
all Tathāgatas provide protection, bestowing peace and happiness upon all without exception.
The World-Honored One’s merit is boundless; those sentient beings who hear it shall not do so in vain.
Causing all to leave suffering behind and always rejoice—this is the entry into the powers of the Sugata by Timapuṣpa.
With his merits fully perfected and his adornments manifest in the world, he has tamed all sentient beings; this Dharma-courage can be clearly realized.
In the past, the Buddha cultivated the ocean of great compassion; His mind, in every thought-moment, was equal to the world.
Therefore, his supernormal powers are boundless; He increases vital energy and can perceive all.
The Buddha is ever-present throughout the world, And no skillful means of his ever go in vain.
Completely purifying all the delusions and afflictions of sentient beings—this is the liberation of the Spirit Universal Birth (Viśvajanin).
This Buddha is a great ocean of wisdom in the world; emitting pure light that reaches everywhere, the vast and great faith and understanding arise from it.
Thus does the Adorned Topknot (Vyūṣitakeśa) clearly enter [into this state].
The Tathāgata, observing the world, gave rise to a heart of compassion;
for the benefit of sentient beings, he appeared and showed them the most supreme path of tranquility and joy.
This liberation of the deity Viśuddhapuṣpa, and the pure conduct practiced by the Sugata, were fully proclaimed beneath the Bodhi tree.
Thus he teaches and transforms throughout the ten directions; this deity of Wondrous Fragrance is able to hear and receive it.
Within all worlds, the Buddha causes all beings to leave sorrow behind and give rise to great joy;
he heals and purifies all their faculties and desires, and this deity of Lovely Delight enters into this realization.

When the Tathāgata appears in the world, he universally observes the inclinations of the minds of sentient beings and brings them to maturity through various skillful means; this is the liberation door of the spirit Pure Light.
Furthermore, the medicinal spirit Auspicious Lord attained the liberation door of diligently gathering in all sentient beings by universally observing their minds.
The medicinal spirit Candanavana, Lord of the Sandalwood Forest, attained the liberation door of gathering sentient beings with radiant light so that those who see it do not pass by in vain.
The medicinal spirit Vimalaprabhā, Lord of Dust-Free Radiance, attained the liberation door of being able to extinguish the afflictions of all sentient beings through pure skillful means.
The medicinal spirit Viśrutayaśas, Lord of Universal Renown, attained [the liberation door] of being able to [utilize] great renown...
The medicinal goddess Increasing the Boundless Ocean of Wholesome Roots attained the liberation door of manifesting light from her pores.

The medicinal goddess Sovereign of Medicines Who Manifests Light from Her Pores attained the liberation door of swiftly responding to the realms of all illnesses through the banner of great compassion.

The medicinal goddess Purifier of Darkness attained the liberation door of healing all sentient beings who are blind and ignorant, causing their eye of wisdom to become pure. The medicinal goddess Sovereign of Universally Uttering Roars...
The medicinal goddess Prabhāvatī attained the liberation door of being able to expound the Buddha’s voice and explain the distinct meanings of all dharmas.
The medicinal goddess Sūryaprabhāketudhvaja attained the liberation door of acting as a spiritual friend to all sentient beings, causing all who see her to generate roots of goodness.
The medicinal goddess Diśāmukhapratibhāsavatī attained the pure treasury of great compassion, which, through skillful means, [can...]

[They attained] the liberation door of causing the arising of faith and understanding; and the medicinal goddess Sovereign of Universal Radiance attained the liberation door of using skillful means to cause sentient beings to recollect the Buddha and eliminate all illnesses.
At that time, the medicinal goddess Auspicious One, empowered by the Buddha’s spiritual authority, [spoke].
Universally observing the assembly of all the medicinal spirit-lords, he spoke in verse:
"The Tathāgata’s wisdom is inconceivable; He fully knows the minds of all sentient beings.
By means of various powers of skillful expedients, He extinguishes the immeasurable suffering of those who are deluded."
The Great Hero’s skillful means are difficult to measure;
Whatever he does never goes in vain, for he ensures that the sufferings of all sentient beings are extinguished. The deity of the sandalwood forest can realize this:
observe how the Buddhas’ teachings are thus— Having diligently practiced throughout immeasurable eons in the past.
Yet they remain unattached to any state of existence; this is the gateway entered by the Light Free from Dust.
Such Buddhas are difficult to encounter even in hundreds of thousands of kalpas;
whoever sees them or hears their names shall all obtain benefit, none passing in vain. This is what the deity Universal Renown understands.
From each and every pore of the Tathāgata, He emits light that extinguishes all afflictions;
He causes all worldly defilements to be exhausted— This is the gate entered by the deity Prabhākara.
All sentient beings are blinded by ignorance; Their delusions, karma, and manifold sufferings are immeasurable.
The Buddha completely eliminates [delusion] and opens the light of wisdom; thus he destroys darkness and is able to behold [all things].
With a single sound that is limitless, he can open the ocean of all dharma-gates, so that all sentient beings who hear it fully understand. This is the liberation of the Great Sound.
Behold the Buddha’s wisdom, inconceivable, Manifesting everywhere in all realms of existence to save all living beings;

It enables all who see it to follow its transformation. This Banner Covering the Sun has deeply realized the ocean of the Tathāgata’s great compassion and skillful means, Appearing for the benefit of the world.
Widely opening the right path to show all sentient beings, This vision of the deity Fang enables thorough understanding.

The Tathāgata universally radiates great light, Illuminating every direction of the ten quarters without exception, Causing them to give rise to merit by recollecting the Buddha; This is the liberation door of "Emitting Majestic Light."
Furthermore, the forest-ruling spirit Flower-Spreading-Like-Clouds attained the liberation door of the vast and boundless treasury of the ocean of wisdom;
the forest-ruling spirit Stem-Erecting-Radiating-Light attained the liberation door of the vast cultivation and purification of goodness;
the forest-ruling spirit Sprout-Blossoming-Radiance attained the liberation door of increasing the sprouts of various pure faiths; [and] Auspicious-Pure-Leaves...
The forest-ruling spirit Sarvaviśuddhaguṇavyūhasamudgata attained the liberation door of the array of all pure merits.
The forest-ruling spirit Jvālāgarbha-avabhāsa attained the liberation door of the universal gate of pure wisdom that constantly surveys the entire dharma-realm.
The forest-ruling spirit Suvyūha-raśmi attained the liberation door of universally knowing the ocean of the conduct of all sentient beings and spreading forth clouds of Dharma.
The forest-ruling spirit Pleasing Thunder-Sound attained the liberation door of enduring all unpleasant sounds and manifesting pure sounds.
The forest-ruling spirit Universal Fragrant Light attained the liberation door of universally manifesting throughout the ten directions the spheres of vast conduct cultivated in the past.
The forest-ruling spirit Radiant Circular Splendor attained [the liberation door] through all merits...

The liberation door of benefiting the world through the Dharma of virtue; and the liberation door of the Forest-Ruling Spirit named Lord of Flower-Fruit-Light-Taste, who has attained the ability to cause all to see the appearance of a Buddha and to always reverently remember him without forgetting, thereby adorning the treasury of merit.
At that time, the Forest-Ruling Spirit named Cloud-like Flower-Spreader, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of forest-ruling spirits and said:
He spoke in verse:
"In the past, the Buddha cultivated and accumulated the practices for awakening;
his merit and wisdom were fully perfected, and he was endowed with all powers. He emitted great radiance that transcends the world."
The gate of compassion is immeasurable and equal to all sentient beings; In the past, the Tathāgata universally purified it.
Therefore, he is able to bring benefit to the world; This is what the deity Netrodbhava understands.
If there are sentient beings who see the Buddha even once, He will surely cause them to enter the ocean of profound faith.
Universally revealing the path of all Tathāgatas— this liberation of the deity Subhūṣita,
wherein the merits gathered within a single hair-pore cannot be fully proclaimed even throughout oceans of eons;
the skillful means of all Buddhas are inconceivable, and the deity Viśuddhapattra can clarify this profound meaning.
I recall how the Tathāgata, in the past, made offerings to infinite Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of a world-system;
at the site of each Buddha, his wisdom gradually became clearer—this is what the spirit Jvālākara understands.
The ocean of all sentient beings' various actions, the World-Honored One fully knows them all in a single thought-moment.
Thus, this wondrously adorned spirit is able to awaken to and enter The vast,
unimpeded wisdom that constantly emanates the Tathāgata’s tranquil and sublime voice; It universally gives rise to peerless and great joy,
Causing all to realize awakening according to their understandings and desires— This is the Dharma practiced by Cloud Thunder Sound.
The Tathāgata manifests great supernormal powers, pervading all lands throughout the ten directions;
he causes all that was practiced by the Buddha in the past to be seen—this is the gate entered by Universal Fragrance Light.
Sentient beings are deceitful and do not cultivate virtue; deluded, they sink and flow within the cycle of birth and death.
To clarify for them the path of manifold wisdom—this is what the deity Sublime Light perceives.
For the sake of sentient beings hindered by karmic obstructions, the Buddha appears only once in an interval of hundreds of millions of eons;
yet for others, he causes them to behold him constantly in every thought-moment—this is what the deity Flavorful Light contemplates.
Furthermore, the mountain spirit named Jewel Peak Blooming Flower attained the liberation door of entering the light of the great tranquil concentration.

The mountain spirit named Flower Forest Wondrous Topknot attained the liberation door of cultivating and accumulating roots of goodness through kindness and compassion to bring inconceivable numbers of sentient beings to maturity.
The mountain spirit named High Banner Universal Illumination attained [the liberation door of] observing the minds of all sentient beings.
The mountain spirit Joyful Adornment of the Pure Faculties attained the liberation door of the joyful adornment of all faculties.
The mountain spirit Jewel Topknot Free from Dust attained the liberation door of tireless and unflagging diligent effort throughout an ocean of boundless eons.

The mountain spirit Light Illuminating the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of universally awakening others through the light of boundless merit. The mountain spirit Great Power Radiance attained the ability to spontaneously accomplish...
The mountain spirit Sovereign of Thorough Repeated Practice attained the liberation door of causing sentient beings to abandon delusion and practice the path of liberation.
The mountain spirit Sovereign of Universal Victorious Splendor attained the liberation door of uprooting all suffering so that nothing remains.

The mountain spirit Sovereign of Subtle Secret Light-Circles attained the liberation door of manifesting the radiance of the teaching to reveal the merits of all Tathāgatas. The mountain spirit Universal Eye Manifest Vision...
The Mountain Spirit Sovereign of the Eye, Vajra-Firm, attained the liberation door of causing all sentient beings, even within their dreams, to increase their roots of goodness;
the Mountain Spirit Sovereign of the Eye attained the liberation door of manifesting an ocean of boundless great meanings.
At that time, the Earth-Ruling Mountain Spirit named Blooming Flowers All Around, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of mountain-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
"In the past, you cultivated supreme practices without limit; Now, you have attained spiritual powers that are likewise immeasurable."
The Dharma gates are widely opened, as numerous as atoms, Causing all sentient beings to deeply awaken and rejoice.
With various marks adorning their bodies throughout the world, The radiance from their pores is entirely pure.
Through great compassion and skillful means, they reveal everything; Huālín Miàojì has awakened to this gate.
The Buddha’s body manifests everywhere without limit, filling all worlds throughout the ten directions;
his faculties are pure and adorned, bringing joy to all who behold him.
This Dharma-banner can be realized by those who have diligently practiced through kalpas without weariness, remaining unstained by worldly dharmas like empty space.
Through various skillful means, he transforms the multitudes of living beings; Awakening to this Dharma gate is called "Jewel Topknot.
Sentient beings, blind and in darkness, enter perilous paths;
The Buddha, out of compassion for them, extends his light to shine everywhere, causing the world to awaken from sleep. Through his majestic radiance, they awaken to this mind and give rise to joy.
In the past, while dwelling in the various realms of existence, you extensively practiced cultivation and made offerings to countless Buddhas as numerous as the atoms of a world-system,
causing sentient beings to see them and give rise to great vows. On this ground, through great power,
you are able to clearly enter and perceive how all sentient beings wander through the suffering of saṃsāra, perpetually entangled and shrouded by all karmic obstructions.
With the light of wisdom, they completely extinguish [all darkness];
from every single pore of this Samantavijaya-deity’s liberation, wondrous sounds emerge,
praising all Buddhas according to the minds of sentient beings throughout immeasurable eons across the ten directions— this is the gateway of the Light-Circle.
The Buddha appears everywhere throughout the ten directions, universally manifesting before all beings;
through various skillful means, he expounds the wondrous Dharma, extensively benefiting the ocean-like practices of sentient beings. This is the Dharma-door realized by the Spirit Manifest Vision:
like the ocean, it is boundless in measure; with a single voice, he explains it so that all may understand.
Expounding inexhaustibly throughout all kalpas; entering this skillful means, the Vajra-Eye.
Furthermore, the Earth-Ruling Spirit Universal Virtue Pure Flower attained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings with every thought through a mind of compassion.
The Earth-Ruling Spirit Adorned with Firm Merit attained the [liberation door] of universally manifesting the merit of all sentient beings.
The earth goddess Virtue-Power Liberation Gate attained the liberation gate of universally entering all dharmas to produce the adornments of all Buddha-fields.

The earth goddess Lord of Trees Adorned with Exquisite Flowers attained the liberation gate of practicing various samādhis to cause sentient beings to eliminate obstacles and defilements. The earth goddess Pure Eyes Observing Time attained...
The earth-ruling spirit Golden-Wondrous-Eye attained the liberation door of manifesting all pure bodies to subdue sentient beings.
The earth-ruling spirit Fragrant-Hair-Radiance attained the liberation door of knowing the great power of the ocean of merits of all Buddhas. The earth-ruling spirit Tranquil-Sound-Delight...
The earth goddess Manasīśvarī attained the liberation door of universally sustaining the ocean of vocal sounds of all sentient beings.
The earth goddess Sumanāvartamakuṭā attained the liberation door of the stainless nature that fills the buddha-fields.
The earth goddess Vajrasamantadhārī attained the liberation door of the universal manifestation sustained by the wheel of the Dharma of all Buddhas. At that time...
The earth-ruling spirit Samantaguṇaviśuddhikusuma, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of earth-ruling spirits and spoke in verse:
“In the Tathāgata’s past, in every single thought-moment, The gates of great compassion were unspeakable.”
Thus practicing without end, one attains a firm and indestructible body.
All the masses of merit belonging to all sentient beings and bodhisattvas throughout the three periods of time appear within a single pore of the Tathāgata;
having seen this adornment of merit, one gives rise to joy.
The vast and tranquil samādhi, which manifests a pure land— neither arising nor ceasing,
neither coming nor going— to all sentient beings; this is the liberation of the tree-flower deity,
attained by the Buddha through his cultivation of various practices in the past, in order to cause sentient beings to eliminate their heavy obscurations.
The Earth-Ruling Spirit Universal Dispenser of Myriad Jewels, seeing this liberation, gives rise to joy;
the realm of the Tathāgata is boundless, appearing universally in the world in every thought-moment.
The Earth-Ruling Spirit Pure Eye Contemplating Time, seeing the Buddha’s conduct, her heart is filled with delight.
With wondrous voices infinite and inconceivable, universally extinguishing the afflictions of all sentient beings;
with golden eyes and a divine power of realization, they perceive the Buddha’s boundless and supreme merits.
All forms and appearances manifest as transformations, completely filling the dharma-realm throughout the ten directions.
Gandharvarājapramuktaśrī always beholds the Buddha; thus she universally transforms all sentient beings.
Her wondrous voice pervades the ten directions as she preaches for the sake of the masses throughout immeasurable eons.
The Earth Goddess Manojñā fully understands this; having heard it from the Buddha, she feels profound reverence and joy.
From the pores of the Buddha’s body, clouds of fragrant flames emerge;
According to the minds of sentient beings, they pervade the world, maturing all who behold them. This is the realm perceived by Puṣpāvarta;
it is as firm and indestructible as a diamond, Unshakable and surpassing Mount Sumeru.
The Buddha’s body abides thus in the world, universally sustaining all so that they may behold it and give rise to joy.
Furthermore, the city-ruling spirit Jewel-Peak Radiance attained the liberation door of benefiting sentient beings through skillful means.
The city-ruling spirit Adorned with Exquisite Palaces attained the liberation door of knowing the faculties of sentient beings and teaching them to reach maturity. Pure...
The City-Ruling Spirit Joyful Treasure attained the liberation door of "Constant Delight that Causes All Sentient Beings to Receive All Merit and Virtue.
The City-Ruling Spirit Free from Sorrow and Pure attained the liberation door of "The Great Compassion Treasury that Rescues from All Fears.

The City-Ruling Spirit Flower Lamp Flame-Eye attained the liberation door of "Universal Clarity of Great Wisdom. The City-Ruling Spirit Radiant Banner of Flames... [attained the liberation door of] Manifesting Light.
The City-Ruling Spirit Attaining Universal Skillful Means obtained the liberation door of manifesting universal skillful means.
The City-Ruling Spirit Abundant Merit and Majestic Light obtained the liberation door of universally observing all sentient beings and causing them to cultivate a vast ocean of merit.
The City-Ruling Spirit Pure Radiant Body obtained the liberation door of awakening all ignorant and dark-sighted sentient beings. [The City-Ruling Spirit] Fragrant Topknot Adornment...
The city-ruling goddess Prabhāvatī attained the liberation door of beholding the Tathāgata’s sovereign power that pervades the world to tame and liberate sentient beings.
The city-ruling goddess Ratnaśikharaprabhā attained the liberation door of being able to shatter the mountains of obstacles for all sentient beings with great radiance.
At that time, the city-ruling goddess Ratnaśikharaprabhāsa, sustained by the Buddha’s awesome power, surveyed everywhere.
The entire assembly of City-Ruling Goddesses spoke these verses:
"The Guide is thus inconceivable; His light shines universally throughout the ten directions.
Sentient beings see the Buddha manifest before them, Teaching and bringing to maturity countless beings."
The various faculties of all sentient beings are each distinct; The Buddha knows them all without exception.
O Goddess of the City of the Wondrously Adorned Palace, Entering this Dharma-gate, her heart is filled with joy.
The Tathāgata practiced for immeasurable eons, Protecting and upholding the teachings of all past Buddhas.
The mind constantly serves with joy; the deity of the City of Wondrous Jewels has realized this gate.
The Tathāgata has already been able to dispel all the terrors of sentient beings, and thus he constantly gives rise to compassion toward them;
the deity Free from Sorrow has realized this joy in her heart.
The Buddha’s wisdom is vast and boundless, Like space, it cannot be measured.
The deity of the city of Kusumākṣa, having realized this, rejoices;
One who can study the Tathāgata’s wondrous wisdom Sees the Tathāgata’s physical marks as equal to all sentient beings, Appearing to each according to their inclinations and desires.
The flaming banner of light clearly appears, and the mind is able to awaken; practicing these skillful means, one gives rise to joy.

The Tathāgata, having cultivated an ocean of manifold merits in the past, possesses a pure, vast, and boundless banner of light of merit within this gate; observing and fully awakening to it, the mind rejoices.
Sentient beings are deluded within the various realms of existence, Like those born blind in this world who suddenly see nothing;
The Buddha arises in the world for their benefit. The deity Pure Light enters this gate:
The Tathāgata’s sovereign mastery is boundless, Like clouds pervading the entire world.
Even manifesting in dreams to bring them to discipline—this is what the sentient beings seen by Gandhavyūha perceive:
blinded by the darkness of ignorance and shrouded by various hindrances and obscurations, the Buddha’s light shines through and causes them all to open wide; such is the entry of Ratnaśikhara.
Furthermore, the arena deity Pure Adorned Banner attained the liberation door of the power of vows to manifest vast adornments for making offerings to the Buddhas.
The arena deity Sumeru Jewel Light attained the liberation door of manifesting before all sentient beings to accomplish vast practices for enlightenment.
The arena deity Thunder Sound Banner Mark attained [the liberation door] to follow one...

The Bodhisattva Flower-Rain Wondrous-Eye, the deity of the site of enlightenment, attained the liberation door of being able to rain down all manner of difficult-to-renounce precious ornaments as adornments. [She also attained] the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to see the Buddha in their dreams according to the inclinations of their hearts and preaching the Dharma for them so they may attain liberation.

The Dharma-assembly deity Pure Flame Form attained the liberation door of being able to manifest wondrous adornments within the dharma-assembly to extensively transform sentient beings, causing them to reach maturity and liberation.
The Dharma-assembly deity Flower Garland Hanging Topknot attained the liberation door of preaching the Dharma according to faculties to give rise to right mindfulness.
The Dharma-assembly deity Rain of Jewel Adornments attained the liberation door of being able to universally rain down boundless [teachings] through eloquence.

The liberation door of the Dharma-gate of Joyful Delight; the liberation door of the Dharma-gate of Universally Praising the Merits of All Buddhas attained by the Ritual Ground Deity Valiant Fragrant Eye;
the liberation door of the Dharma-gate of Adorning the Ritual Ground with Trees Manifesting Boundless Forms and Colors attained by the Ritual Ground Deity Vajra-Colored Cloud;
and the liberation door of the Dharma-gate of Tranquility beneath the Bodhi Tree attained by the Ritual Ground Deity Lotus Radiance.
The liberation door of being unmoving yet pervading the ten directions;
the liberation door of manifesting the various powers of the Tathāgata, attained by the Site-Spirit Radiant Light.
At that time, the Site-Spirit Banner of Pure Adornment, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed all the hosts of site-spirits and spoke in verse:
I recall how, in times past, the Tathāgata practiced his cultivation for immeasurable eons;
he made offerings to all the Buddhas who appeared in the world, thereby attaining great merit as vast as space.
In former times, the Buddha practiced inexhaustible giving, equal in measure to the atoms within immeasurable buddha-fields.
The Bodhi-spirit Meru-prabhāsa-ābhāsa, recollecting the Sugata with a joyful heart,
beholds the Tathāgata’s physical marks as inexhaustible; manifesting transformations throughout all lands,
he constantly appears even within dreams— seeing this, Vajra-dhvaja gives rise to great joy.
In the past, throughout immeasurable eons, you practiced the conduct of relinquishment; you were able to give away even that which is difficult to give, such as eyes like the ocean.

Through such acts of relinquishment for the sake of sentient beings, this Eye of Sublime Wisdom has been able to awaken to and delight in infinite forms and marks, clouds of jewel-flames, manifesting at the site of enlightenment throughout the world.
The Pure Realm Deity of Flame Form, seeing the Buddha’s sovereign power, gives rise to joy;
The ocean of sentient beings’ conduct is boundless, yet the Buddha universally pervades it, raining down the rain of Dharma.
According to their faculties and dispositions, he removes their doubts and delusions; The Flower-Garland Deity, awakening to this, rejoices with a joyful heart.
The meanings of the distinctions of immeasurable Dharma-gates— The ocean of eloquence can enter them all.
The deity of the site who rains down precious ornaments Constantly maintains this state in every thought-moment of the mind.
Throughout unspeakably many lands, They praise the Buddha with all the words of the world.
Thus one attains renown and great merit; this Heroic Eye can recollect various forms and infinite trees.
Universally appearing beneath the King of Bodhi Trees amidst clouds of diamond-colored light, one awakens to this gate and constantly gazes upon the Tree of the Path with joy.
The limits of the ten directions cannot be found, And the wisdom of the Buddha seated at the site of enlightenment is likewise so.
With pure faith, taking steps like lotus-light, One enters this liberation and gives rise to profound joy.
From the entire site of enlightenment, wondrous sounds emerge, Praising the Buddha’s inconceivable and pure power.
Furthermore, the spirit Subhāṣitaghoṣa is able to hear and receive [the teachings on] the accomplishment of all causal practices.
Next, the footstep-traveling spirit Ratnamudrā attained the liberation door of universally raining down all kinds of jewels to give rise to vast joy.
The footstep-traveling spirit Padmaprabha attained the liberation door of manifesting the Buddha-body sitting upon a lotus throne of all radiant colors.
The footstep-moving spirit Delighting Those Who See attained the liberation door of causing those who behold her to rejoice and be liberated.
The footstep-moving spirit Most Excellent Flower Topknot attained the liberation door of establishing the assemblies and sites of enlightenment of all Tathāgatas within every single thought-moment.

The footstep-moving spirit Gathering All Good Views attained the liberation door of subduing boundless sentient beings with every lift of foot and step. [The footstep-moving spirit] Wondrous Jewel Star Banner...
The footstep-following spirit Attaining Various Lotus Net Radiance in Every Thought-moment attained the liberation door of universally raining down all kinds of jewels and emitting sublime sounds.
The footstep-following spirit Delighting in Emitting Sublime Sounds attained the liberation door of giving birth to an ocean of boundless joy.
The footstep-following spirit Sandalwood Tree Light attained the liberation door of universally awakening all beings with fragrant winds.

The liberation door of the assembly at the site of enlightenment; the footstep-following spirit Lotus Radiance attained the liberation door of emitting light from all pores to proclaim the subtle and wondrous sound of the Dharma;

the footstep-following spirit Subtle Radiance attained the liberation door of his body universally emitting various nets of light that shine everywhere; the footstep-following spirit Accumulated Exquisite Flowers...
[This is] the liberation door of causing all sentient beings to attain awakening and give rise to an ocean of roots of goodness.
At that time, the footstep-following spirit Jewel Seal, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty, surveyed the entire assembly of footstep-following spirits and spoke in verse:

In the past, throughout immeasurable eons, the Buddha practiced the path, making offerings to all Tathāgatas with a heart ever joyful and never weary. His gate of joy is profound and vast like the ocean;
his supernormal powers in every thought-moment are immeasurable, as he manifests lotuses of various fragrances.
The Buddha sits upon it, traveling everywhere; the red-hued light-spirit sees them all.

Such is the Dharma of the Buddhas, the Tathāgatas: throughout the vast assemblies pervading the ten directions, they universally manifest inconceivable supernatural powers, which the supreme Flower-spirit clearly beholds.
Throughout all lands in the ten directions, wherever they lift their feet or set them down, they are able to bring all living beings to fulfillment.
This deity Sunetra, his mind awakened with joy, manifests bodies as numerous as all sentient beings;
each and every one of these bodies fills the entire Dharma-realm.
They emit pure light everywhere and rain down various jewels; such is the liberation of Star Banner, which enters the boundless realm of the Tathāgata.
Universally raining the rain of Dharma, it fills the entire assembly;
seeing the Buddha, all give rise to joy—this is what is seen by the one named Wondrous Sound.
The Buddha’s voice is equal in measure to space; all sounds are contained within it.
There is nowhere it does not pervade as it tames sentient beings.
Thus, from every pore of this sandalwood [statue], emanated voices are able to be heard, proclaiming the names of all Buddhas of the three periods of time.
All who hear this sound rejoice; thus does the deity Padmaprabha behold the inconceivable manifestations of the Buddha’s body.
At every step, his physical forms are like the ocean, appearing to all according to the minds of sentient beings—this is what is attained through this wondrous radiance.
The Great Spiritual Power Universally Manifesting in the Ten Directions causes all sentient beings to attain awakening;
the Spirit of Myriad Wondrous Flowers, having seen this Dharma, felt great joy in his heart.
Furthermore, the Spirit of the Body of the Realm of Pure Joy attained the liberation door of recollecting the ocean of the Buddha’s past vows.
The body-spirit named Light Illuminating the Ten Directions attained the liberation door of obtaining a radiance that universally illuminates boundless worlds.
The body-spirit named Ocean-Sound Subduer attained the liberation door of using a great voice to universally awaken all sentient beings, causing them to rejoice and be subdued.
The body-spirit named Pure Flower Adorned Topknot attained the liberation door of a body like space, dwelling pervasively everywhere.
The gate of the Body-Host Spirit of Immeasurable Dignified Postures, who attains the liberation door of manifesting the realm of all Buddhas to all sentient beings;
the gate of the Body-Host Spirit of Supreme Radiant Adornment, who attains the liberation door of causing the physical strength and vitality of all famished sentient beings to be fully satisfied;
and the gate of the Body-Host Spirit of Pure Light Fragrant Clouds, who attains the liberation door of removing the defilements of affliction from all sentient beings.
The body-guarding spirits of the liberation gate attained the liberation gate of turning back the demonic activities of ignorance in all sentient beings.
The body-manifesting spirits of universal appearance attained the liberation gate of universally displaying adorned forms within the palaces of all world-rulers.
The body-spirits of immovable radiance attained the universal gathering of all [beings].
The liberation door that causes all who are born to give rise to pure roots of goodness.
At that time, the Body-Multitude Spirit of the Realm of Pure Joy, empowered by the Buddha’s majestic authority, surveyed all the assemblies of body-multiplicity spirits and spoke in verse:
I recall that eons ago, as numerous as the atoms of Mount Sumeru, there was a Buddha named Wonderful Light who appeared in the world.
At the place of that Tathāgata, the World-Honored One resolved his mind to make offerings to all Buddhas.
That Tathāgata’s body emitted a great radiance, and its light pervaded the entire Dharma-realm without exception.
Sentient beings who encounter [this] have their minds tamed; this is what the deity Fangzhao (Illuminating the Quarters) perceives.
The Tathāgata’s voice resounds through the lands of the ten directions, all vocal sounds being perfectly complete;
he universally awakens all living beings without exception, and those who hear this are joyful and celebrate in their hearts as they are tamed.
The Buddha’s body is pure and eternally quiescent; It universally manifests all colors yet possesses no marks.
Thus it dwells pervasively throughout the world— This is the entryway of the goddess Viśuddhapuṣpā.
The Guide is thus inconceivable; According to the minds of sentient beings, he causes them all to see him.
Whether sitting, walking, or sometimes standing, through the gateways of awakening in immeasurable modes of conduct, the Buddha—
whom one encounters with difficulty even in hundreds of thousands of eons— arises to bring benefit with sovereign power,
enabling the world to leave behind all suffering of poverty; thus does the Most Victorious One, Adorned with Supreme Light, enter this place.
Between each of the Tathāgata’s teeth, clouds of fragrant lamp-flames are universally emitted,
extinguishing the delusions of all sentient beings. The deity Vimalamegha saw that sentient beings are heavily obstructed by defilements and delusions, constantly wandering along the paths of Māra.
The Tathāgata reveals the path of liberation; Guarding and upholding it, one can enter my contemplation.
Through the sovereign power of the Tathāgata, light is spread To completely fill the entire Dharma-realm.
Dwelling in royal palaces to transform sentient beings— This is the sphere of the Universal Manifestation Body.
Sentient beings, deluded and possessed of manifold sufferings, The Buddha dwells within them, constantly providing protection;
Causing all delusions to be extinguished and giving rise to joyful hearts— This was beheld by the Spirit Immovable Light.
Furthermore, the Vajra-holding Spirit Varṇa-nārāyaṇa Beheld the Tathāgata manifesting infinite forms.
The Vajrapāṇi deity Body of Marks and Liberation attained the liberation door of manifesting clouds of various light-radiance from every single pore of the Buddha’s body, like the solar disc.
The Vajrapāṇi deity Sumeru Flower Light attained the liberation door of the great supernormal power of manifesting infinite bodies. The Vajrapāṇi deity Pure Cloud Sound...
The Vajrapāṇi deity Sovereign of Wondrous Arms attained the liberation door of manifesting as the lord of all worlds to awaken sentient beings.
The Vajrapāṇi deity Delightful Radiance attained the liberation door of universally revealing the distinctions of all Buddha-dharmas, exhausting them all without exception. Great...
The Vajra-holding spirit Tree Thunder-Sound attained the liberation door of gathering all tree spirits through delightful and beautiful ornaments.
The Vajra-holding spirit Lion-King Radiance attained the liberation door of fully understanding the vast accumulation of the Tathāgata’s merit and adornments.
The Vajra-holding spirit Secret Flame Auspicious Eye attained the universal...
The liberation door of manifesting a majestic body to observe the minds of beings who are treacherous and evil;
and the liberation door of the Vajra-holding deity Padma-maṇi-śikhara, who universally rains down all ornaments for Bodhisattvas from his maṇi topknot.
At that time, the Vajra-holder deity Suvarṇavarṇanārāyaṇa, empowered by the Buddha’s majesty,
surveyed the entire assembly of Vajra-holders and spoke in verse:
You should contemplate the Dharma King; such is the nature of the Dharma King: His physical marks are boundless, appearing everywhere throughout the world.

From each and every pore of the Buddha’s body, An inconceivable net of light radiates, like a pure solar disc, Universally illuminating the lands of the ten directions—such is the supernatural power of the Tathāgata.
The Dharma-realm pervades everywhere before all sentient beings;
The Tathāgata manifests inexhaustible bodies, and the sound of his preaching fills the ten directions so that none fail to hear it.
According to the various classes of sentient beings, he causes their minds to be fully satisfied. All see the Honored Muni dwelling within the palaces of the world.
Universally for the sake of all living beings, you proclaim the Great Dharma;
In the swirling depths of the ocean of Dharma, you explain all its diverse meanings Through various gates of skillful means, expounding them without end.
With boundless great skillful means, you universally respond to the lands of the ten directions, Encountering the pure light of the Buddhas.
They see the body of the Tathāgata in its entirety, making offerings to all Buddhas;
their merit, numbering as the atoms within billions of lands, is like space, and they are the object of universal veneration.
By the power of their supernormal faculties, they appear equally in all lands, sitting serenely at the sublime site of enlightenment and manifesting themselves before all beings.
The clouds of flames illuminate everywhere, with various lights perfectly complete; nothing in the Dharma-realm is left unpenetrated—this demonstrates the sphere of action of the Buddhas.
Next, from the Fire God named Universal Radiance Flame-Treasury down to the Vajra-wielding Spirit named Subtle-Colored Nārāyaṇa.
Thereafter, the assembly born together with him praised his virtues.
*The Essentials of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Fascicle Four;
*The Essentials of the Avataṃsaka Sūtra*, Fascicle Five.
Translated by the Tripiṭaka Master Śikṣānanda, a śramaṇa from the Kingdom of Khotan;
with a commentary on the meaning by the śramaṇa Chengguan of Dàhuá yán Temple at Mount Qingliáng;
and further extracted and clarified by the śramaṇa Hanshan Deqing of Fáyún Temple on Mount Kuāng in Ming China.
Chapter One, Part Five: The Sublime Array of the World-Lords.
Furthermore, the Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra entered the ocean of skillful means of the inconceivable gates of liberation and the ocean of the Tathāgata’s merits.
Among them, there is a gate of liberation called "Adorning and Purifying All Buddha-lands."
They subdue sentient beings, causing them to attain ultimate liberation. There is a gate of liberation called "Universally Reaching the Spheres of Perfected Merit Cultivated by All Tathāgatas.
There is a gate of liberation called "Establishing the Ocean of Great Vows of All Bodhisattva Stages.
There is a gate of liberation called "Universally Manifesting Infinite Bodies as Numerous as the Microscopic Dust-Particles of the Dharma Realm. There is...
There is a gate of liberation called "Proclaiming the Inconceivable Number of Distinctions Throughout All Lands.
There is a gate of liberation called "Manifesting the Boundless Supernormal Powers and Realms of All Bodhisattvas Within Every Single Atom.

There is a gate of liberation called "Manifesting the Events of the Formation and Destruction of Kalpas of the Three Times Within a Single Thought-Moment. There is a gate of liberation called "Demonstrating..."
They manifest the ocean of faculties of all bodhisattvas, each entering its own respective realm.
There is a gate of liberation called "Able to Manifest Various Bodies through the Power of Supernormal Knowledges, Pervading the Boundless Dharma Realm.
There is a gate of liberation called "Displaying the Sequential Stages of All Bodhisattva Practices, Entering the Vast Expedient Means of Omniscience. At that time...
The Bodhisattva-Mahāsattva Samantabhadra, by means of his own merit and further sustained by the majestic spiritual power of the Tathāgata,
